jobTitle: Executive/ Senior Executive, Private and Shared Mobility (Shared Mobility)
agencyDescription:
The Mission of Ministry of Transport is to develop Singapore's land, sea and air transport sectors so as to enhance our economic competitiveness and quality of life in a knowledge-based economy. MOT oversees the development and regulation of the following sectors:

• Civil Aviation and Air Transport
• Maritime and Ports
• Land Transport

Besides providing an efficient and cost-effective transportation in Singapore, it also strives to make Singapore an international civil aviation and maritime centre for the region.

The ministry sets the strategic and policy direction while operations and regulatory works are carried out by the statutory boards under its charge. There are four statutory boards which are established by Acts of Parliament: the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (CAAS), the Land Transport Authority (LTA), the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) and the Public Transport Council (PTC). Go Green SG (GGSG) is a national movement to rally the community to take collective action towards a more environmentally sustainable and climate-resilient Singapore. We are looking for interns to join our team to plan and execute GGSG 2027. 

The internship offers undergraduates the opportunity to contribute to the planning and delivery of a national sustainability movement, while gaining practical experience in public-sector programme management, stakeholder engagement, event operations, communications and programme evaluation.

Interns may also have opportunities to attend selected GGSG activities, such as workshops, learning journeys and behind-the-scenes visits to sustainability facilities that are not ordinarily open to the public.

Roles and responsibilities 

(i) Partner Outreach & Engagement

You will be involved in reaching out to prospective partners from the people, public and private (3P) sectors and engaging them to participate in GGSG. You will serve as a primary point of contact for GGSG partners, managing inquires and cultivating strong relationships. 

You will work closely with partners to shape their activities and programme offerings so that they align with GGSG’s sustainability theme. You will review partner activity submissions for completeness and clarity, follow up on missing information, and organise activity information for publication, publicity and reporting.

You will also collate feedback and data from GGSG partners and participants to facilitate reporting of GGSG activities and assist with other outreach and engagement activities organised by the team.

(ii) Publicity and Marketing

You will be involved in content generation on digital platforms to promote GGSG activities and partners. You will assist in populating the GGSG website, with event updates on partner activities. You will also have opportunities to write feature stories and create social media content on GGSG activities, and design posters and collaterals to promote GGSG activities.

(iii) Project and Programme Management

You will also support the planning and delivery of key GGSG engagements, including sessions with partners and the GGSG launch. This may involve coordinating invitations and RSVPs, preparing event materials, supporting rehearsals and venue setup, and assisting with registration, ushering, partner booths and guest management.

You will be involved in maintaining project trackers, monitoring milestones, coordinating follow-up actions and supporting the preparation of status updates and management reporting.

A trade mark can be any word, name, letter, numeral, device, shape, colour, aspect of packaging, or a combination of such elements. In some cases, even sounds or holograms may qualify. From the Singapore Airlines bird logo to the DBS quatrefoil, trade marks help businesses build distinctive brands and protect their reputation.

You may also contribute to the formulation and implementation of national trade mark policies, supporting Singapore’s position as a global hub for intellectual property and intangible assets.

This training combines on-the-job learning, with mentoring and formal instruction provided, and requires sustained commitment and dedication from the job holder.
jobResponsibilities:
Examining a trade mark application requires a combination of sound thinking, good judgment, strong analytical skills, and some understanding of, or an interest in how businesses brand, market and identify themselves.

1. Assess distinctiveness Determine whether a proposed trade mark is capable of distinguishing the trade origin of the relevant goods or services.
2. Conduct searches for conflicting marks Identify earlier trade marks on the Singapore trade mark register that may conflict with the application.
3. Review specifications of goods and services Examine the description of goods and services applied for, with reference to international classification standards.
4. Communicate examination outcomes and provide guidance
Correspond with applicants or their legal representatives on examination outcomes, including raising objections where necessary, and assessing responses received. Provide guidance and assistance to members of the public who have queries on trade mark-related matters.

jobDescription:
We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer / Software Test Analyst to take strong ownership of quality assurance for enterprise web applications operating in a dual-mode environment of production support and continuous feature delivery.
The role will independently plan, prepare, execute and drive testing activities end-to-end,   ensuring that system changes, production fixes, enhancements and integrations meet business requirements, quality standards and release-readiness expectations. The successful candidate must be hands-on, dependable and able to work with minimal supervision, while proactively identifying requirement gaps, edge cases, integration impacts and quality risks. The role requires the ability to test both conventional application functionality and AI-enabled capabilities, including workflows where outputs may be probabilistic or non-deterministic.
The role will also strengthen regression coverage and progressively implement appropriate test automation to improve testing efficiency, repeatability and confidence in releases.
jobResponsibilities:
Test Planning, Analysis and Preparation
•	Review and understand business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, solution changes and production fixes.
•	Independently determine test scope, approach, scenarios, dependencies, test data and areas of risk.
•	Develop, execute and maintain automated test scripts, and integrate appropriate automated tests into QA cycles and SHIP-HATS CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing, regression assurance and release quality gates.
•	Perform impact analysis and ensure appropriate functional, integration and regression coverage for each change.
•	Proactively identify and challenge unclear, incomplete or inconsistent requirements, including edge cases, negative scenarios and downstream impacts, before they become release issues.
•	Work closely with Business Analysts, developers and business stakeholders to clarify expected system behaviour and testability.

Test Execution
•	Own and execute assigned testing activities independently with minimal supervision, from preparation through completion.
•	Perform functional, system, integration, API/interface, end-to-end and regression testing, where applicable.
•	Validate complex business rules, workflows, role-based access, data processing, interfaces and asynchronous/background processes across relevant systems.
•	Perform database and data validation using SQL or equivalent techniques where required.
•	Retest fixes and conduct risk-based regression testing to confirm that changes do not adversely affect existing functionality.
•	Maintain complete, accurate and auditable test evidence and test results.
•	Execute and analyse automated tests within SHIP-HATS CI/CD pipelines, investigate test and pipeline failures, and distinguish application defects from test-script, configuration, environment and deployment issues.
AI-Enabled Capability Testing
•	Plan and execute testing for AI-enabled capabilities and end-to-end workflows spanning application, integration and AI components.
•	Validate AI-assisted document ingestion, classification, extraction and processing across representative document types, formats and quality conditions, where applicable.
•	Evaluate AI-generated outputs against expected business outcomes and source evidence, including completeness, accuracy, consistency and traceability.
•	Design and maintain representative test datasets and expected outcomes to support repeatable evaluation and regression testing of AI-enabled capabilities.
•	Apply appropriate testing and evaluation approaches for probabilistic or non-deterministic outputs rather than relying solely on exact-output assertions.
•	Validate human-in-the-loop workflows, including user review, amendment, approval, rejection and appropriate recording of user actions.
•	Verify that relevant AI-generated outputs are traceable to supporting source information and that appropriate audit information is captured.
•	Test confidence thresholds, exception handling, fallback behaviour and escalation to human review where applicable.
•	Perform regression testing following changes to models, prompts, knowledge sources, business rules, configurations or other AI components that may affect system outcomes.
•	Work with Product Owners, business users, developers and relevant technical teams to define acceptance criteria, evaluation datasets and appropriate quality thresholds for AI-enabled capabilities.

Defect Management and Quality Risk
•	Identify, document and report defects clearly with sufficient reproduction steps, evidence and impact assessment for efficient investigation.
•	Drive defects through triage, prioritisation, investigation, resolution, retesting and closure, working closely with developers and relevant vendors.
•	Assess defect severity, business impact and regression risk, and escalate material quality concerns early.
•	Identify recurring defects, systemic quality issues or testing gaps and recommend preventive improvements.
•	Provide an objective, evidence-based view of residual quality risk and release readiness.

UAT, Production Support and Release Assurance
•	Support business users during UAT, including preparation of scenarios, test data and supporting materials where required.
•	Support defect triage and timely resolution during SIT/UAT and production-support cycles.
•	Provide clear and timely reporting on testing progress, coverage, outstanding defects, blockers, risks and recommended actions.
•	Support pre-release checks, deployment verification, production sanity testing and post-deployment verification where required.
•	Support release assurance through SHIP-HATS, including verification of automated test results, quality gates, deployment outcomes, smoke/sanity testing and relevant release evidence before production promotion.
•	Investigate production issues from a QA perspective and ensure relevant scenarios are incorporated into regression coverage.
•	Provide a clear recommendation on test completion and quality readiness before production release.

Test Automation and Continuous Improvement
•	Assess and recommend practical test automation approaches, tools and priorities based on delivery needs and return on effort.
•	Identify stable, repeatable and high-value regression scenarios suitable for automation.
•	Develop, execute and maintain automated test scripts and integrate them into QA cycles where appropriate.
•	Review automated test results, investigate failures and maintain scripts as the application evolves.
•	Continuously improve test coverage, QA standards, templates, traceability, evidence quality and testing efficiency.
•	Explore appropriate use of AI-enabled tools for test design, automation scripting, defect analysis and other QA activities, with proper validation of outputs.
Identify appropriate approaches for automating repeatable evaluation and regression testing of AI-enabled capabilities, recognising that probabilistic outputs may require different validation techniques from conventional deterministic test automation.
jobRequirements:
•	Preferably 5+ years of relevant experience in software testing / quality assurance for enterprise IT systems, with demonstrated ability to work independently and own testing outcomes.
•	Strong experience in preparing test strategies or plans, scenarios, test cases, test data and regression suites.
•	Strong functional and regression testing experience for web-based or enterprise applications with complex business workflows.
•	Experience testing APIs, interfaces or integrations between multiple systems, including end-to-end data flows.
•	Experience in defect management, including impact assessment, triage, retesting and closure.
•	Hands-on experience with test automation tools or frameworks and the ability to implement and maintain practical automation solutions.
•	Able to translate business and functional requirements into comprehensive test coverage and independently identify missing scenarios or requirements.
•	Strong analytical, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with attention to detail and sound quality judgement.
•	Able to communicate defects, testing status, risks and release-readiness assessments clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
•	Able to work effectively with business users, Product Owners, Business Analysts, developers, technical teams and vendors in an Agile/Scrum delivery environment.
•	Familiarity with defect and work-management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps or equivalent.
•	Experience testing AI/ML-enabled, intelligent automation, document-processing or other systems involving probabilistic or non-deterministic behaviour; alternatively, demonstrated ability to understand and apply appropriate AI testing and evaluation techniques.
•	Able to design test scenarios and evaluation datasets for outputs that cannot always be validated through simple deterministic pass/fail assertions.
•	Able to validate end-to-end data and workflow behaviour across user interfaces, APIs, backend services, integrations and AI-enabled components.
•	Strong understanding of data quality, boundary conditions, negative testing, traceability and evidence-based validation.
•	Able to distinguish defects in application logic, integration, data, configuration and AI-generated behaviour, and work with the relevant technical teams to support root-cause investigation.

Good to Have
•	Working knowledge of SQL and experience performing database/data validation.
•	Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or equivalent.
•	Experience working with SHIP-HATS or equivalent DevSecOps/CI/CD platforms, including integrating automated tests into delivery pipelines, reviewing pipeline test results and supporting automated quality gates.
•	Experience testing asynchronous processing, queues, scheduled jobs or system-to-system integrations.
•	Experience supporting UAT, production releases, hotfixes and post-deployment verification.
•	Experience working in a dual-mode environment covering both BAU production support and continuous Agile delivery.
•	Experience with OutSystems or other low-code application platforms.
•	Experience in government, regulated or security-conscious enterprise environments.
•	Experience testing AI/ML, Generative AI, OCR, intelligent document processing or retrieval-based applications.
•	Familiarity with AI evaluation concepts and techniques, including reference or ground-truth datasets, accuracy and quality metrics, confidence thresholds, unsupported-output testing and regression evaluation.
•	Experience validating document classification, extraction or OCR accuracy across different document formats and quality conditions.
•	Familiarity with testing human-in-the-loop workflows and traceability of AI-generated outputs to supporting source information.
•	Familiarity with evaluating changes to prompts, models, knowledge sources or AI configurations and assessing their impact on existing behaviour.
•	Experience using AI-enabled tools responsibly to improve QA effectiveness.

 
Key Attributes
The successful candidate should be:
•	Ownership and independence - Takes accountability for QA outcomes and progresses work with minimal supervision.
•	Reliable - Provides accurate status, follows through on commitments and maintains disciplined test evidence.
•	Analytical - Looks beyond expected test paths to identify gaps, exceptions, dependencies and potential risks.
•	Proactive - Raises requirement gaps, blockers and quality risks early and proposes practical actions.
•	Quality-focused - Exercises sound judgement on release risk and provides confidence that the system is fit for intended use.
•	Collaborative - Works constructively across business and technical teams while being prepared to challenge when quality is at risk.
•	Automation-minded - Identifies where automation can improve regression coverage, repeatability and efficiency.
•	Adaptable - Comfortable supporting planned sprint delivery as well as production incidents, fixes and changing priorities.

Role Outcome
The role is expected to provide dependable, independent QA ownership and confidence that system changes and production fixes have been adequately tested, defects and residual risks are clearly understood, and stakeholders have sufficient evidence to make informed release decisions.
The role should progressively strengthen regression coverage, test automation and overall QA discipline, while identifying quality risks earlier in the delivery lifecycle and supporting stable production operations alongside continuous feature delivery.

This is an 11-month non-renewable contract position. Please note that officers appointed on short-term contracts of less than one year are not eligible for bonus payouts.

jobDescription:
You will join our data science team in developing agentic AI and conversational analytics capabilities for policy analysis. These capabilities allow users to query and analyse structured data, survey data and housing market news using natural language, and include AI assistants for statistical modelling and forecasting.

Several related projects may run concurrently. Interns will be assigned to one or more projects based on project needs and their skills. The solutions will be developed primarily in Python on AWS SageMaker, leveraging cloud-based data, analytics and AI services.
jobResponsibilities:
Depending on the assigned project, responsibilities may include:

- Developing a coordinating layer that interprets users’ questions, selects appropriate data sources, retrieval methods and analytical tools, and combines their outputs into a coherent response.
- Converting existing analytics and modelling capabilities into reusable tools, and exploring the use of Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect them through a common interface.
- Improving the housing market news and sentiment analytics application, including its data processing, retrieval and analytical capabilities.
- Exploring more autonomous AI agents that can plan, execute and validate analyses with human oversight.
- Developing an offline conversational analytics solution using open-weight language models.

These projects build on RSM’s existing conversational data-analysis prototypes and planned integration, orchestration and autonomous-analysis workstreams.
jobRequirements:
- Good foundation in Python, SQL, data processing and statistical analysis.
- Ability to use AI coding tools effectively, while applying sound judgement to understand, test and validate their outputs.
- Ability to quickly digest technical documentation and research on large language models, agentic workflows, information retrieval and conversational analytics, and critically assess, adapt and integrate relevant approaches into working solutions.
- Ability to work independently and collaborate with the project team.

Special Considerations:
Third- or fourth-year university students studying Computer Science or Data Science. Strong second-year students with relevant technical experience may also be considered.

Applicants who are available only on a part-time basis during the academic term must be able to continue the internship on a full-time basis during the subsequent summer vacation.

Experience with AWS SageMaker, APIs, agent frameworks, information retrieval, open-weight language models or statistical modelling would be useful, but is not essential.

jobDescription:
The Community Relations Unit (CRU) was established to address severe neighbour noise disputes and hoarding cases as part of the enhanced Community Disputes Management Framework. CRU was piloted in Tampines HDB estates from April 2025, and the model was expanded nationwide on 1 September 2026.

While most neighbour disputes can and should be resolved through dialogue and mediation, a small minority involve excessive and prolonged noise disturbances that cause significant distress to multiple residents. CRU focuses on these severe neighbour noise cases across public and private housing estates. 

As Team Leader (Investigation and Enforcement), you will lead a team of Community Relations Officers (CROs) and oversee the end-to-end management of investigations and enforcement actions for CRU cases. You will report to the Deputy Director of CRU.
jobResponsibilities:
You will provide operational leadership and oversight for CRU’s investigation and enforcement work, ensuring that cases are managed effectively, consistently and in accordance with established policies and procedures.

Your key responsibilities will include the following:
• Providing direction and supervision to CROs, and ensuring that investigations and enforcement actions are thorough, timely and conducted in accordance with established SOPs.
• Leading engagements with partner agencies, such as HDB, PA, SPF and AIC, to coordinate the effective management of cases.
• Reviewing and clearing CROs’ case submissions, enforcement documents and service replies to ensure their accuracy, quality and compliance with established requirements.
• Providing management with timely updates on case progress, key issues and matters requiring further direction.
• Developing CROs’ capabilities through coaching, appropriate training and regular feedback.
• Reviewing and developing recommendations to improve SOPs.

This role offers the opportunity to lead a newly established nationwide function and contribute directly to supporting residents affected by severe neighbour noise disputes.
jobRequirements:
• Leadership and supervisory experience in an operational environment.
• Experience in investigation and enforcement.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with sound judgement in handling complex and sensitive cases.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present case findings and recommendations clearly and succinctly.
• Empathy, sensitivity and the ability to appreciate residents’ perspectives when handling complex or contentious cases.
• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to work effectively with residents, frontline officers and partner agencies.

The Health Promotion Board’s vision is to make Singapore a nation of healthier people.

Evidence, data insights and technology are used to guide decisions, personalise support, strengthen delivery and improve outcomes across partners.
jobResponsibilities:
As Assistant Director, Operations Excellence & Programmes (Physical Activity), you will report to the Head of Department and lead, organise and develop the team to deliver its full range of workstreams and outcomes. Your success will depend on building a capable, accountable and well-coordinated team, setting clear direction and ensuring effective execution across two equally important complementary portfolios: strengthening operational excellence across the physical activity programme landscape, and overseeing the delivery and governance of department-led physical activity programmes. Through the team, you will turn strategic direction and partnership approaches into coordinated workplans, deploy resources and ensure programmes are of high quality and delivered safely, consistently and effectively for residents.


Across both portfolios, lead the team to deliver. Set direction, organise the team around its workstreams and translate priorities into an integrated workplan. Deploy resources, assign accountable workstream leads, coach officers, review performance and manage dependencies, risks and escalation so the team delivers its collective outcomes.


Operations Excellence portfolio

Set operational governance and assurance. Establish practical standards, processes, controls and reporting across the physical activity programme landscape. Oversee quality assurance, audits, operational risks and incidents, and ensure corrective actions are completed and lessons applied.


Provide visibility of operational performance. Develop indicators, dashboards and assurance reviews that give management clear sight of operational health, service quality, control effectiveness and emerging risks, and drive timely follow-up.


Drive continuous improvement and productivity. Simplify workflows, strengthen controls and improve productivity using data, feedback and root-cause analysis. Assess suitable automation, AI and digital tools, and support teams across the organisation to adopt better ways of working.


Programmes portfolio

Oversee portfolio planning and programme delivery. Work with the department’s Strategy and R&D team to translate agreed direction into viable plans. Guide programme managers on capacity, deployment, budgets, timelines, dependencies and risk controls, and keep delivery aligned with intended outcomes and resident needs.


Maintain programme performance and governance. Oversee outcomes, participation, service quality, safety, access, budgets and vendor performance. Direct recovery actions where needed, resolve material trade-offs and hold programme managers accountable for follow-through.
jobRequirements:
We are looking for a leader who has successfully run a team to deliver multiple, interdependent workstreams. You should be able to set direction, create the conditions for strong team performance and drive outcomes through others, while connecting strategy with delivery and strengthening operations. You should bring:


  • Qualifications: A degree in Business or Operations Management, Engineering, Quality Management, Data Analytics, Economics, Public Health, Health Services Management, Exercise and Sport Science, or a related discipline. Relevant professional certification is an advantage.
  • Experience: At least 7–10 years in operations excellence and programme management, including substantial experience leading a team to deliver multiple workstreams and holding workstream leads accountable in a multi-stakeholder environment.

agencyDescription:

jobDescription:
The Health Promotion Board’s vision is to make Singapore a nation of healthier people.

Come be a part of this journey if you’re passionate about creating boundary-pushing work that drives behavioral change.

You will be part of HPB’s Research, Evaluation and Monitoring (REM) division, which drives the development of data-driven insights and analytics to inform health promotion strategies across HPB. The division focuses on translating cutting-edge research and emerging technologies into HPB programmes. By distilling learnings from diverse datasets, applied research, and innovative pilots, REM supports the translation of evidence into practice for delivery in national-scale platforms. The division also plays a key role in strengthening programme design, evaluation, and continuous improvement, ensuring that interventions are evidence-based, outcomes-driven, and relevant for real-world implementation.
jobResponsibilities:
As a member of the Analytics and Translation team in the Research, Evaluation and Monitoring division, you will work in a cross-functional, matrix team to contribute to high-impact projects in priority growth areas.


You will generate actionable insights through advanced analytics on diverse datasets (e.g. large longitudinal cohorts, sensors, and combined datasets), applying appropriate statistical and machine learning approaches to support risk prediction, population segmentation, and identification of behavioural patterns.


You will support the development and application of predictive models and segmentation approaches (e.g. clustering) to inform programme targeting, intervention design, and risk stratification, ensuring outputs are robust, interpretable, and relevant for real-world decision-making.


You will set up and support behavioural experiments and programme evaluations, including contributing to study design, data preparation, and analysis to distil research insights and evaluate suitability for translation into programme delivery.


You will develop compelling data-driven narratives for impactful storytelling to both internal and external stakeholders, translating technical findings into clear, concise, and actionable insights that inform programme and policy decisions.


You will work with cross-functional teams and external partners to support collaborations and analytics projects, contributing to delivery of strategic outcomes and facilitating knowledge sharing and learning across teams.


You will support the development of data pipelines, feature engineering, and preparation of datasets to enable efficient and scalable analytics, including working with relevant data platforms where required.
jobRequirements:
The ideal candidate will be a dynamic and self-motivated individual with a strong interest in advancing health promotion through data, research, and analytics. The candidate should be comfortable working at the intersection of data science and real-world application, and is motivated by translating insights into impact at scale.


The candidate should also possess:

  • Degree in statistics, data analytics, social sciences, life sciences, public health, or any related quantitative discipline
  • At least 2–6 years of practical experience working with data as an analyst or in a related role
  • Experience in applying statistical techniques and/or machine learning methods (e.g. regression, clustering, predictive modelling) to real-world datasets
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g. R, Python). Familiarity with Databricks, SparkR, PySpark or working with large datasets will be advantageous
  • Additional familiarity with statistical software (e.g. SPSS, STATA) will be a bonus
  • Familiarity with programme evaluation methods or quasi-experimental study designs will be advantageous
  • Strong communication skills, especially in communicating technical findings to a non-technical audience
  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Comfortable working independently and as part of a team
  • Strong sense of intellectual curiosity and willingness to learn and seek continuous improvement
  • Adaptable, flexible, and able to take initiative and prioritise among competing demands

Successful candidates will be offered a 2-year contract in the first instance.

jobDescription:
Family Life Group (FLG), under the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) strengthens and supports families through their different life stages. Our work spans policies, programmes, and public education efforts, all in service of making Singapore the best place for family life.

The Inter-Generational Support Division (IGS) sits within FLG and focuses on three areas: encouraging pre-planning through the Lasting Power of Attorney (LPA); protecting the dignity and interests of vulnerable persons who lack mental capacity under the Mental Capacity Act; and supporting the resolution of maintenance disputes between parents and their children through the Tribunal for the Maintenance of Parents (TMP).
jobResponsibilities:
As an Investigation Officer in the IGS Investigation and Litigation Unit, you will play a critical role in safeguarding vulnerable persons who may lack mental capacity. You will investigate allegations of abuse, neglect, financial exploitation, and misuse of authority involving LPA Donees and court-appointed Deputies under the Mental Capacity Act (MCA). Your investigations will support enforcement and legal decisions that protect vulnerable persons and maintain public confidence in Singapore's mental capacity framework. You will:
• Conduct end-to-end investigations into alleged abuse and misconduct by LPA Donees and court-appointed Deputies, from case assessment and evidence gathering to the preparation of investigation findings and recommendations.
• Interview whistleblowers, vulnerable persons (where appropriate), witnesses, and subjects of investigation, exercising professionalism, empathy, and sound judgement.
• Gather, review, analyse, and document financial, social, medical, and other evidential materials while maintaining proper evidence management and investigative standards.
• Identify investigation risks, assess safeguarding concerns, and recommend appropriate intervention, enforcement, or legal actions
• Work closely with the IGS Litigation team in cases involving court applications, including the revocation of LPAs and deputyship orders.
• Partner with MSF's Investigation Branch and other government agencies on investigations and enforcement actions relating to offences under the MCA.
• Contribute to the enhancement of investigation methodologies, SOPs, case management systems, and risk assessment frameworks, including the adoption of digital and data-driven solutions
• Analyse investigation trends and emerging risks to strengthen operational policies, controls, and preventive measures.
jobRequirements:
• Relevant education in any discipline
• Experience in investigations, audit, compliance, enforcement, regulatory work, financial crime, fraud risk management, casework, social service, or related fields will be an advantage.
• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to assess complex information, evaluate evidence objectively, and exercise sound judgement in reaching investigation findings and recommendations.
• Ability to plan and conduct investigations, including gathering, assessing, and documenting evidence from multiple sources in accordance with established procedures and legal requirements.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to conduct interviews, engage case parties professionally, and prepare clear, concise, and well-reasoned investigation reports
• Ability to analyse records and documents, identify inconsistencies, gaps and risks, and apply relevant legislation, policies, and procedures to investigative work.
• Ability to manage sensitive interactions with diverse stakeholders, including uncooperative or difficult parties, while maintaining professionalism, empathy, and impartiality.
• Ability to work independently, prioritise competing demands, and deliver quality outcomes within timelines.
• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships with internal and external partners.
• Proficient in leveraging digital, data and AI tools to enhance productivity, strengthen analysis, enhance case management, and drive continuous improvement.
• Commitment to continuous learning and professional development, including keeping abreast of developments in investigation practices, legislation, technology, and AIenabled tools.

The work location is in Bishan. You will be notified whether you have been shortlisted within 4 weeks from the closing date of this job posting.

jobDescription:
The Income Security Policy Division (ISPD) leads MOM’s efforts in empowering Singaporeans to plan and save for a secure retirement. Within ISPD, the Financial Planning Programme Department (FPPD) spearheads strategic communications, research, policy development, and international advocacy efforts to improve Singaporeans' financial wellbeing and retirement adequacy. FPPD also co-leads MoneySense, Singapore's national financial education programme, with the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), helping Singaporeans manage their money well and make informed financial decisions on their own.

You will drive the research agenda on financial literacy and policy reviews on retirement adequacy, lead the development of behavioural nudges to encourage positive financial planning behaviour and support international advocacy work. This includes leading the design and implementation of key surveys, analysing survey findings, undertaking deep dives to identify areas for improvement, and conducting cross-country research, landscape scans and responses to international information requests. You will also conduct research studies, including behavioural insights studies, using appropriate qualitative and quantitative methods to generate actionable insights for financial literacy initiatives, communications and partnerships and CPF policy reviews. 

You will work closely with agencies such as CPF Board and the Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI) to leverage synergies across research plans for financial literacy and retirement planning, including on policy communications and enhancements to their digital services. You will also facilitate collaborative data sharing with MoneySense partners and academia, as well as collaborate closely with other relevant agencies.
jobResponsibilities:
•	Lead the development of the engagement and partnership strategy with (i) government agencies to infuse financial literacy messaging at government touchpoints and digital services; and (ii) non-government entities to create awareness and encourage positive financial actions at life stages 
•	Lead the conduct of quantitative and qualitative research studies/projects of ISPD, which would include managing third-party vendors and other key stakeholders (e.g. academia)
•	Support international advocacy efforts through research and coordination of responses to international information requests on financial literacy and retirement adequacy
•	Provide data cuts and further analysis for survey findings as requested by the team or other MoneySense stakeholders
•	Prepare and present key survey findings and analysis at relevant platforms
jobRequirements:
•	Qualification in a relevant field such as Business, Data Science, Economics, Psychology, Social Science, Statistics or Public Policy
•	At least 5 years of working experience, preferably in policy research
•	Experience with quantitative, qualitative and behavioural insights research methods and analysis (e.g. surveys, focus groups)
•	Competent in analysing data, with experience in statistical analysis, data visualisation using R, Python other analytical software

This includes growing a network of individuals whose skills, affinity and influence could strengthen Singapore’s business and talent ecosystem, along with enhancing international mindshare of Singapore as a vibrant global hub in Asia.

SGN is reimagining its digital experience through a single community platform that will transform how our members and partners connect, engage and interact with us.

As our founding User Experience (UX) lead for this platform, you will play a key role in shaping this platform from the ground up. Starting with our website redesign, you will lead the design of intuitive, seamless and engaging digital experiences across core platform features including member sign-in, profiles, the contribution hub and funding portal.

This is a multi-year roadmap, with at least two years to establish the foundation of the platform. Working closely with SGN's community building and product development teams, you will have the opportunity to shape how SGN members and partners experience our digital platforms from the start, while laying the groundwork for its continued evolution.

For more information on SGN, please visit www.singaporeglobalnetwork.gov.sg
jobResponsibilities:
As the Product Designer (UX/UI) in SGN, your responsibilities include but are not limited to:


User Experience & Product Design and Improvement

  • Lead the end-to-end UX/UI design of SGN’s new community platform, from user journeys, information architecture and wireframes to interactive and high-fidelity web and mobile application prototypes.
  • Design intuitive and seamless user journeys across key platform features, including member sign-ins, profiles, the contribution hub and funding portal, ensuring a cohesive user experience.

Design Systems & Continuous Improvement

  • Build and maintain SGN’s design system (components, patterns, tokens, documentation) to ensure consistency across the platform as new features are introduced, so visual updates can be rolled out centrally rather than screen by screen.
  • Evolve the platform’s digital look and feel over time, balancing current design practice against usability, accessibility and brand continuity.
  • Leverage analytics and user feedback to test and refine what ships, and inform decisions on product improvements and priorities.

Cross-functional Collaboration & Design Leadership

  • Partner closely with SGN product managers, engineers, and marketing officers to conduct discovery and translate requirements and insights into user-centred design solutions.
  • Communicate design concepts and recommendations clearly, building alignment across stakeholders and championing for user-centred design across all digital products.
  • Define SGN’s digital design standards and design roadmap, contributing to the team’s longer-term growth and mentoring future designers.
jobRequirements:
• 6-8 years in UX/UI or product design, with a strong portfolio showing shipped products.
  • Experience building or scaling a design systems.
  • Strong research and interaction design skills, with proficiency in moving from user interviews to high-fidelity prototypes in Figma or other similar platforms.
  • Strong systems thinking, with the ability to design user journeys across various systems and touch points, including user on-boarding flows.
  • Good understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG), responsive design and technical considerations when collaborating closely with engineers.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity for a 0 to 1 platform, balancing immediate delivery needs with longer-term goals: you can ship something useful early while designing for where the platform needs to be in three years.

jobDescription:
The Economist Service is the premier service for economists in the Singapore public sector. By developing a core group of professional economists, the objective of the Economist Service is to sharpen economic analysis in the public sector in order to improve public policies.

Economists in the Economist Service undertake economic research and analysis in many Ministries and agencies across the public sector. These include the Ministry of Energy, Trade and Industry, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Manpower, Ministry of Social and Family Development, Ministry of Health, and Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment. Through postings to diverse Ministries and agencies, the economists contribute their expertise to inform a wide range of public policies, from economic policies to fiscal, socio-economic, health, security and infrastructural policies.
jobResponsibilities:
You will be part of a team of economists whose primary focus is to develop a comprehensive evidence base to support policy formulation in Singapore. Together with your team, you will strive to keep abreast of the latest economic/socio-economic issues in our public discourse, be at the forefront of the latest economic ideas and thinking, and be thought leaders on economic issues within the Singapore public sector. This will be achieved through:

(i) Identifying pertinent “hot-button”, emerging and/or longer-term economic/socio-economic issues in Singapore by conducting pre-emptive sensemaking;

(ii) Synthesising what is currently known about these issues by drawing on existing research studies and the experience of other economies to form an evidence base; and

(iii) Leading research and policy projects to provide insights on these issues within the Singapore context if there are gaps in the existing literature.
jobRequirements:
* Degree / Master’s / PhD in Economics. While a postgraduate degree will be advantageous, strong candidates with an undergraduate degree will also be considered.

* Strong quantitative skills (e.g., econometrics) for policy modelling and simulations, as well as impact evaluation studies.

* Strong passion for empirical research and extensive experience in solving complex problems using quantitative approaches.

* Proficiency with statistical/programming software (e.g., STATA, R, Python).

* Ability to distil, synthesise and explain the key insights from existing research studies and economic theory.

* Strong interest and a willingness to develop expertise in a diverse range of issues, including economic structure and growth, sustainability and resilience, labour market, internationalisation and investments, as well as productivity and innovation.

* Excellent communication skills, including an ability to express complex ideas simply and clearly.

Interested candidates should submit a copy of the latest educational certificate and transcripts from 'A' Levels or Diploma onwards, including unofficial transcripts (if any), to facilitate the processing of your application. If there are any coursework projects or thesis in Economics, please submit a copy for reference too.

Info-communications Media Development Authority (www.imda.gov.sg) offers a rewarding career that gives you a front seat in the fast-changing infocomm media sector, where technology and content are shaping the way people view the world more than ever.

We offer a wide range of opportunities, where talented individuals and teams can make a difference. Whether you are developing a telecommunications policy affecting consumers or spearheading a scheme to nurture budding media talents, each member of IMDA contributes towards driving innovation, enhancing productivity for economic growth, and improving the quality of life for all Singaporeans.

As a statutory board in the Ministry of Communications and Information, IMDA promotes and regulates the infocomm and media sectors.
jobDescription:
IMDA is spearheading Singapore’s drive to be a world-leading Digital Economy. Within IMDA, the BizTech Group (BTG) drives innovation and adoption across emerging technologies, including robotics and quantum communications, to advance Singapore’s digital future.

Sitting at the intersection of IMDA’s central Communications & Marketing Division and BTG, this role will lead the strategic communications, branding and public engagement for BTG’s emerging technology portfolio. As robotics and intelligent systems increasingly move beyond controlled environments into public spaces, a key focus will be on building public awareness, understanding and acceptance of these technologies.

A core priority will be shaping the communications and positioning of the Punggol Digital District robotics precinct, one of Singapore’s most ambitious testbeds for the deployment of autonomous and intelligent systems.

Join us in our journey architecting Singapore’s digital future.
jobResponsibilities:
• Develop a compelling, evidence-based narrative to drive awareness and understanding of BTG’s work in the emerging technology space. Translate complex technology concepts into compelling, accessible stories for policymakers, industry, media, and the public, while considering national interests, public perception and partner sentiments.

  • Establish and manage the brand identity and positioning for BTG's emerging technology portfolio, including the Punggol Digital District robotics precinct. Develop co-branding and messaging frameworks — including a message house that serves BTG's broader portfolio — to ensure consistency and synergies across different organisational voices, while allowing partners to amplify the narrative authentically.

  • Represent IMDA in cross-agency communications functions related to the BTG portfolio, serving as the primary communications interface between IMDA and partner agencies, industry stakeholders, and academia. Lead coordination on communications priorities, narrative alignment, and joint engagement efforts across the Punggol Digital District precinct and other BTG projects.

  • Lead stakeholder management and communications coordination for the Punggol Digital District, managing relationships with precinct partners, aligning messaging timelines, and brokering communications decisions across a complex multi-stakeholder environment. Ensure that partner communications are coherent, timely, and consistent with IMDA's broader narrative.

  • Identify and optimise digital and social media channels to maximise reach, leveraging platforms within IMDA as well as partners’ channels.

  • Drive and implement public engagement strategy, fostering a culture of collegiality, seamless collaboration and joint accountability.

  • Establish monitoring and reporting routines to track sentiment, reach, and engagement. Use data-driven insights to manage communications, mitigate emerging risks, recommend course corrections, and provide evidence-based counsel to senior leadership across collaborating agencies. In the event of an incident or reputational risk, lead the development and execution of crisis communications responses, working swiftly across internal and external stakeholders to manage public perception and protect organisational trust.

  • Develop shared playbooks, messaging guides, and engagement templates that raise the baseline quality of engagement across BTG.

  • Mentor and guide team members to elevate communications and public engagement capabilities for BTG.
jobRequirements:
• At least 15 years of relevant experience in strategic communications, public relations, public engagement or marketing.

  • Proven track record in multi-agency stakeholder management (including industry and academia) and public engagement frameworks.

  • Ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, with the confidence and judgement to provide candid, well-reasoned counsel.

  • Strong narrative development skills with the ability to understand needs of the business units and translate complex emerging tech into clear messaging.

  • Analytically minded, with experience setting and tracking communications metrics and using data to back strategy refinement.
  • undefined
  • Deep experience in media relations, with familiarity pitching local and international/business media.

  • Comfortable operating in a matrixed environment, with the ability to build credibility and manage relationships across multiple organisational teams simultaneously.

  • Experience in crisis communications, including developing response frameworks, managing media enquiries under pressure, and coordinating across stakeholders during sensitive or high-profile situations, is an advantage.

  • Exceptional written, verbal, and executive presentation skills.

Position will be commensurate with the candidate’s qualifications and experience.

jobDescription:
In an era of rapid change, ServiceSG is at the forefront of transforming public service delivery — organising services around a citizen-centric journey via a digital concierge (LifeSG), a physical concierge (Service Centres) and its contact centre serves as an outsourced shared service for onboarded agencies, and acts as the central call centre during national crises.

ServiceSG contact centre also leads the WOG Resilience Community, an inter-agency crisis contact-centre network that brings together government contact centres to strengthen crisis preparedness and surge response capabilities. During national emergencies, the Community operates as a coordinated network, supported by shared manpower, technology and operating models, to ensure citizens continue to receive timely, consistent and reliable assistance. 

Working together with the Assistant Director, the Manager / Assistant Manager will be responsible for the execution of the concept of operations for the WOG Resilience Community, by operationalising ServiceSG’s Core Central Contact Centre Tech Stack (C4TS) across the satellite contact centres, driving AI adoption and automation, running systems-integration and interoperability checks, and maintaining the crisis operations playbooks and business-continuity plan.
jobResponsibilities:
Reporting to the Assistant Director, these will be your areas of responsibilities:

Operating and Optimising the Core Central Contact Centre Tech Stack (C4TS)

• You will operationalise and manage the C4TS stack — encompassing Amazon Connect telephony and Salesforce/Service Connect CRM systems — across the satellite contact centres of the Resilience Community.
• You will work with the IT team and IT vendors to manage system configuration, access provisioning, and a common knowledge base that serves as the single source of truth for consistent citizen-facing answers across agencies, ensuring stable and reliable operations at all times.

Driving AI Adoption and Automation

• You will lead the charge on AI and automation in the contact centre space — piloting AI-agent solutions for the national crisis hotline and with Crisis Management Group (CMG) Lead Ministries such as MOH.
• You will run structured technology trials encompassing fit-gap analysis, piloting, and scale-up decisions, translating emerging technologies into tangible capacity and productivity gains that enhance the government's ability to serve citizens at scale during a crisis.

Ensuring Systems Integration and Interoperability

• You will lead annual systems-integration and interoperability checks across the satellite contact centres, coordinating trunk lines with GovTech and agencies to ensure seamless end-to-end case visibility.
• You will work to ensure that shared data and case tracking are robust enough that no citizen case is dropped or delayed.

Maintaining Crisis Playbooks and Business Continuity

• You will own and continuously refine the crisis operating playbooks, activation SOPs, and ServiceSG's business-continuity plan, ensuring they remain tested, current, and actionable.
• You will run the technology-readiness components of the annual exercise, stress-testing systems and processes against real-world crisis scenarios and closing gaps identified along the way.

Managing Technology Vendors and Delivery Partners

• You will manage relationships with technology vendors and coordinate deliverables and timelines with GovTech and the internal IT team, ensuring on-time and on-specification delivery of technology solutions.
• You will navigate complex multi-party delivery environments with clarity and accountability, keeping all partners aligned to the team’s operational and crisis-readiness objectives.

Supporting Satellite Centre Operations and Stakeholder Alignment

• You will work closely with CMG Crisis Lead Ministries to develop IVR options and knowledge management frameworks for onboarded services, and support Resilience Community members in satellite-centre systems operations.
• You will align technology solutions to operational workflows in partnership with ServiceSG's contact centre operations team, ensuring that the technology always serves the people using it.

You consider the perspectives of different stakeholders, including agency partners and Resilience Community members, in your efforts to streamline contact centre operations and scale winning solutions.

About EDB
The Singapore Economic Development Board (EDB), a government agency under the Ministry of Energy, Trade and Industry (METI), is responsible for strategies that enhance Singapore’s position as a global centre for business, innovation, and talent. About the EDB Associate Programme
The global economy is constantly changing. Technologies are reshaping industries, businesses are rethinking where and how they invest, and competition between economies continues to intensify. For Singapore to stay ahead, we need officers who are versatile, resilient and able to make sense of these shifts to identify opportunities and translate them into meaningful outcomes.

The EDB Associate Programme (AP) is a 10-month programme designed to build the foundations of a career at EDB. Through structured training, personalised mentorship and rotations across different areas of EDB’s work, you will gain first-hand exposure to how we work with companies, industries and partners to shape Singapore’s economic future.

Work alongside colleagues in a high-performing, collaborative environment and be part of a team that cares deeply about Singapore’s success and challenges one another to do better.
jobResponsibilities:
What the Programme Entails

Your Associate journey begins with a structured bootcamp that introduces you to EDB’s mission, work and ways of working, and equips you with foundational skills.

You will then be rotated across multiple divisions. Each rotation will give you opportunities to experience new challenges and work with different colleagues and stakeholders. Through these rotations, you will gain exposure to the core areas of EDB’s work:

1) Investment Promotion – Engage directly with companies to understand their business strategies and make the case for Singapore as an investment destination. This involves building relationships with senior business leaders, analysing industry trends, structuring project proposals, and negotiating with companies on the terms of their commitments to Singapore.

What you develop: Business acumen, relationship management and an understanding of global business dynamics

2) Industry Development – Beyond individual company relationships, EDB works to strengthen our economic sectors. We do so by mapping out an industry’s ecosystem, identifying gaps in capabilities or talent, and working with companies, trade associations, and other agencies to develop strategies that make Singapore a competitive hub.

What you develop: Systems thinking, strategy formulation, partnership building and the ability to translate insights into actionable programmes or initiatives.

3) Policy and Planning – EDB charts Singapore’s long-term economic trajectory – where the economy is headed, what structural shifts are underway globally, and what that means for Singapore’s positioning. You will work on frameworks, policies and incentives that shape how EDB attracts and retains investments.

What you develop: Analytical and research capabilities, skills in policy development and evaluation, and the ability to synthesise complex information

All Associates will also undergo foreign language training, giving you an early foundation to strengthen your ability to engage businesses and partners from around the world.

jobDescription:
[What the role is]

Singapore is a global hub port and a leading maritime centre. To ensure that ships calling at our port do so safely, they are required to comply with port entry requirements. The ocean-going ships also require services such as fuel (bunker), towing and crew change. These are provided by harbour craft operating in our port. The Marine Licensing & Permits administers port entry requirements, and also licenses harbour craft operating in the Port of Singapore. To support our national decarbonisation goals, MPA has already set goals to reduce the greenhouse gas emissions of our local harbour craft, which will entail a full change in the mode of operations of our companies.
jobResponsibilities:
[What will you be working on]

Reporting to the Marine Licensing and Permits Department, which is part of the Marine Services Division, you will part of a dynamic team that is issuing licenses/permits to ensure vessels operating in Singapore meet the necessary safety standards, certifications, ethical guidelines, and regulatory requirements.

You will also be involved in formulating policies to promote the harbour craft sector, creating a pipeline of seafarers to meet the industry needs and prepare for the decarbonisation milestones of the maritime industry.

Your key responsibilities include:

1. Licensing

  • Oversee the licensing of harbour craft and pleasure craft, ensuring that vessels meet safety, manning and regulatory requirements.

  • Shape forward-looking licensing policies to modernise the harbour craft fleet and support Singapore’s maritime decarbonisation journey.

  • Manage sea space allocation for mooring buoys and develop policies to support their safe and efficient use.

2. Port clearance processes

  • Drive projects to digitalise and simplify customer-facing processes, including licensing applications, enquiries and document submissions.

  • Oversee and support 24/7 port clearance operations to ensure efficient service delivery and timely support to port users.

  • Administer and enforce port clearance requirements to maintain safe, secure and well-regulated vessel movements.

3. Industry Development & Transformation

  • Administer and enforce manpower quota policies that support the sustainable development of the harbour craft sector.

  • Review and develop manpower policies and training initiatives to attract, upskill and retain seafarers.

  • Use harbour craft industry data to identify trends, risks and opportunities that can inform policy and operational improvements.

  • Engage industry stakeholders to understand operational challenges, build support for transformation efforts and encourage the adoption of new technologies.
jobRequirements:
[What we are looking for]

We are looking for people who are keen to make a meaningful contribution to Singapore’s maritime sector. You may have experience in customer-facing service delivery, process improvement, regulatory work, licensing policy, manpower development or the maritime sector. More importantly, you should be proactive, adaptable and motivated to learn, lead change and deliver outcomes in a fast-paced operating environment.

You should have strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage diverse stakeholders both in writing and in person. You should also be comfortable working with data and using insights to support policies, strategies and operational decisions. This role offers exposure to regulatory operations, policy development, digitalisation and industry engagement, and may require occasional duties outside regular office hours.

This job description provides a high-level view of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.
jobRequirements:

  • Experience with data visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau).
  • Prior experience in food safety or public health research.
  • A strong record of peer-reviewed publications in scientific journals.

agencyDescription:
The Health Sciences Authority (HSA) applies medical, pharmaceutical and scientific expertise through its three professional groups, Health Products Regulation, Blood Services and Applied Sciences, to protect and advance national health and safety. HSA is a multidisciplinary authority. It serves as the national regulator for health products, ensuring they are wisely regulated to meet standards of safety, quality and efficacy. As the national blood service, it is responsible for providing a safe and adequate blood supply. It also applies specialised scientific, forensic, investigative and analytical capabilities in serving the administration of justice. 

For more details, visit http://www.hsa.gov.sg/. 

For more updates on public health and safety matters, follow us on Twitter at www.twitter.com/HSAsg and LinkedIn at https://sg.linkedin.com/company/health-sciences-authority.
jobDescription: This position serves to support the Audit Branch (AB) in implementing the regulatory inspection and licensing regime, policies and initiatives governing the full spectrum of dealers across various health product categories in Singapore so as to meet HSA’s national objective of ensuring that these health products meet the required standards of quality, safety and efficacy to safeguard public health and safety.
jobResponsibilities:
• Lead the conduct or conduct of local/overseas regulatory inspections and licensing of manufacturers and dealers of health products and pharmacies ensuring that they conform to Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), Good Distribution Practice (GDP), regulatory requirements and other relevant quality system standards.
  • Lead/assist in the review of regulatory policies and legislations related to manufacturers and dealers of health products and active ingredients and the translation into specific technical and operational plans for implementation to achieve the desired outcome.
  • Lead/assist in the review, development and implementation of technical standards, industry guidelines, internal good practice guidance on GMP inspections
  • Lead/assist the effective implementation of the AB’s Quality Management System (QMS) in accordance with Phamaceutical Inspection Co-operation Scheme (PIC/S), ISO 9001 standard and other international standards, e.g., WHO ML4 & WLA.
  • Lead in/assist in the management and handling of stakeholders’ technical and procedural enquiries.
  • Lead in/assist with performing assessment of changes (URS, UAT, etc.) to electronic processing systems for inspection and licensing.
  • Lead/assist in the inspection scheduling and monitoring of performance indicators related to inspections.
  • Assist the Branch Director and Unit Deputy Director in ensuring that there are effective mechanisms in place to capture, store and communicate key information, experience and knowledge gained by the inspection teams.
  • Work in collaboration with international colleagues to facilitate technical liaison with other regulatory authorities and relevant bodies in the field of GMP inspection.
  • Perform such other duties as the department may reasonably require.
jobRequirements:
• Possess relevant knowledge in scientific or technical disciplines related to health products, such as pharmacy, life sciences, pharmacology, chemistry, chemical engineering, biochemistry, biotechnology, microbiology, genetic/tissue engineering. Or related fields.
  • Relevant experience in pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical manufacturing and/o rquality functions is required. The role is suited to candidates with several years of experience (typically 2–5 years or more). Exposure to sterile manufacturing or aseptic processing would be an advantage.
  • Good understanding in the current international regulatory landscape and developments in the field of manufacture of biopharmaceuticals or cell, tissue and gene therapy products.
  • Passion for GMP inspection work with good knowledge and experience in international GMP standards (e.g., PIC/S GMP).
  • Willingness to travel for overseas inspection work and related work assignments, where required for operational needs.
  • Ability to work as part of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Familiar with the use of computer softwares including word and data processing applications.
  • Communicates both orally and in writing effectively.
  • Proficiency in English is required. Knowledge of additional languages is an advantage.
  • Candidates without prior experience but with the releavnt scientific/technical qualifications are welcome to apply.

The successful candidate will be offered a 1-year contract (with option for automatic renewal for a further one year) in the first instance.

Shortlisted candidates would be contacted within 30 days from the closing date of the advertisement. We regret that only shortlisted candidates would be notified.

jobDescription:
We are seeking a highly motivated Full Stack AI Software Engineer to design, develop, test, deploy and maintain secure, scalable and cloud-native applications. The successful candidate will deliver business solutions using Specification-Driven Development (SDD), AI-assisted development, DevSecOps, Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD), automated quality controls, and modern cloud engineering practices.

The engineer will work closely with Business Users, Product Owners, Solution Architects, Business Analysts, Quality Engineers, DevOps Engineers, Security Teams and Operations Teams throughout the software delivery lifecycle, from idea validation and prototyping through production adoption and ongoing improvement.
jobResponsibilities:
Software Development

  • Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain enterprise-grade applications using Java with Quarkus and/or Spring Boot, Python, React, TypeScript and RESTful APIs.

  • Develop scalable backend services, responsive frontend applications, reusable components, common libraries and well-defined APIs.

  • Apply clean architecture, secure coding, design patterns and appropriate domain modelling to produce maintainable solutions.

  • Design and implement cloud-native applications using containerised architectures and automated deployment practices.

Specification-Driven Development

  • Work with users, Product Owners and Business Analysts to translate business needs into clear specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, API contracts and technical designs.

  • Apply Specification-Driven Development using structured requirements, OpenAPI specifications, Domain Driven Design (DDD), Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD).

  • Maintain traceability from business requirements and specifications through implementation, automated testing, security validation and production release.

  • Use specifications as living engineering assets that support code generation, testing, documentation and change impact assessment.

Proof of Concept and Proof of Value

  • Partner with business users, Product Owners and application teams to identify opportunities for digital transformation, automation, AI adoption and platform modernisation.

  • Design and implement Proof of Concept exercises to validate technical feasibility, integration patterns, security controls and architectural assumptions.

  • Conduct Proof of Value exercises with stakeholders to demonstrate user outcomes, operational benefits, productivity improvement and delivery viability.

  • Develop prototypes, reference implementations and reusable accelerators to shorten technology evaluation cycles.

  • Document findings, constraints, architecture options, risks, recommendations and an adoption roadmap to support evidence-based decisions.

AI-Assisted Software Development

  • Use approved AI-assisted development capabilities to improve engineering productivity, code quality and delivery consistency.

  • Apply Large Language Models to support code generation, unit-test generation, documentation, code review, refactoring and requirements-to-code traceability.

  • Develop and integrate AI-enabled application features using enterprise APIs and approved AI platforms.

  • Apply responsible AI, information protection, security and human review requirements throughout AI-enabled software delivery.

DevSecOps and CI/CD

  • Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, security scanning, packaging, release and deployment.

  • Integrate SonarQube, Nexus IQ, SAST, dependency scanning, secret detection and container scanning into delivery pipelines.

  • Apply quality gates, policy checks and auditable evidence to prevent non-compliant artefacts from progressing through the delivery lifecycle.

  • Troubleshoot and optimise pipelines, build processes, deployment automation and developer workflows.

InnerSource and Engineering Enablement

  • Create and maintain reusable engineering templates, reference architectures, starter kits, common services and best-practice guides.

  • Establish common templates for APIs, microservices, frontend applications, GitLab CI/CD pipelines, security scanning, AI-enabled applications and Infrastructure-as-Code.

  • Promote InnerSource practices that enable discoverability, contribution, code reuse, peer review, transparent ownership and cross-team collaboration.

  • Define contribution guidelines, repository standards, ownership models, versioning practices, documentation expectations and support processes for shared assets.

  • Author engineering standards, onboarding guides, implementation playbooks and developer productivity tools.

Productionisation and Adoption Support

  • Guide application teams through the lifecycle from idea, prototype and POC to MVP, production deployment and operational support.

  • Assess production readiness across architecture, security, data protection, scalability, resiliency, observability, supportability, compliance and cost.

  • Help teams address architecture review, security review, CI/CD automation, testing, operational acceptance, monitoring, incident readiness, backup and disaster recovery requirements.

  • Refactor successful prototypes into production-grade solutions with appropriate engineering controls, documentation, automated tests and support arrangements.

  • Collaborate with platform, infrastructure, security and operations teams to remove adoption blockers and support successful production deployment.

Software Quality Engineering

  • Develop unit, integration, API, contract and end-to-end automated tests.

  • Apply TDD, BDD, clean code, secure coding, peer review and continuous refactoring practices.

  • Participate in code reviews, security reviews and defect analysis, and implement sustainable corrective actions.

  • Monitor code quality, technical debt, dependency risk and test effectiveness using objective engineering evidence.

Cloud and Platform Engineering

  • Deploy and support applications on cloud platforms such as AWS using Docker and Kubernetes or OpenShift.

  • Use Infrastructure-as-Code and automated configuration to provide consistent, repeatable environments.

  • Work with API gateways, messaging, event-streaming, secrets management, logging, metrics and distributed tracing services.

  • Engineer for performance, availability, resiliency, security, operability and cost efficiency.
