Sustainability is integral to Singapore’s long-term growth strategy and economic resilience. At the same time, the global environment for climate action is becoming more complex. Governments, businesses and financial institutions will need to remain nimble, responding to evolving climate-related risks while capturing new economic and investment opportunities.

Against this backdrop, the MAS Sustainability Group plays an important role to support FIs in enabling the regional low carbon transition needs:

i) Energy Transition – supporting financing solutions that enable Asia’s shift towards lower-carbon energy systems, while taking into account energy security, access and affordability;
ii) Adaptation and Resilience – developing and scaling financing solutions to mobilise capital for the region’s climate- and nature-related resilience needs; and
iii) Carbon markets – supporting financial institutions in building capabilities and participating across the carbon market value chain, from project financing and risk mitigation to carbon credit trading.

You will be part of a central team responsible for developing and implementing strategies and initiatives across these areas. Working closely with relevant departments across MAS as well as government and industry partners, you will contribute to efforts to strengthen Singapore’s position as a leading climate and resilience financing centre.
jobResponsibilities:
In this role, you will:


  • Support the Sustainability Group (SG) in key projects aimed at catalysing financing for Asia’s low-carbon transition. The precise portfolio will be determined based on team priorities and the successful candidate’s experience. Areas of work could include:
    • Carbon Markets: working with other government agencies and industry partners on whole-of-economy strategies to grow Singapore as a carbon services and trading hub, as well as initiatives to enable the financial sector to capture opportunities arising from Singapore and regional carbon markets.
    • Adaption and resilience Financing. working with industry and other government agencies to develop and scale financing approaches for regional adaptation and resilience needs.
  • Support account management on entities that MAS has key relationships with. This includes support on brief inputs for strategic meetings, assessments of KPIs and administrative processing of grants during annual reviews.
  • Contribute to cross-MAS sustainability initiatives. This could include assessing developments in Singapore’s sustainable finance ecosystem and markets, contributing to MAS sustainability-related publications, and supporting engagements with international experts and advisory panels.
jobRequirements:
• Relevant work experience in the financial sector is preferred.
  • Knowledge of carbon markets, and adaptation and resilience is an advantage.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to write clearly and synthesise messages
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to positively influence internal and external stakeholders
  • Strong project management skills and able to lead organization-wide projects involving multiple stakeholders
  • A good team player who is proactive and motivated

You will be working in a fast-paced environment that would require the ability to manage multiple priorities and needs of stakeholders, as well as the agility to respond to changes and developments. As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment. This is a 1-year contract.

All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.

jobDescription:

The Public Service Division (PSD) drives efforts to build a world-class Public Service that supports a successful and vibrant Singapore. Through leadership development, capability building, and service excellence, PSD aims to strengthen the effectiveness and quality of public sector delivery. 

As part of the Service Transformation and Planning team within ServiceSG, you will lead service transformation initiatives across key citizen journeys. Working closely with government agencies and stakeholders, you will redesign service delivery processes and drive change management efforts to enhance citizen-centricity, efficiency, and overall public service experience. 


Job overview 

ServiceSG aims to transform how citizens experience public services — moving from a system where people must navigate multiple agencies to one that is integrated, personalised, and seamless, where the Public Service “Knows and Serves You as One, and with Heart.” 

Our omni-channel service delivery system brings together LifeSG, a central digital platform, a network of ServiceSG Centres, and a central contact centre. 

Together, we integrate over 600 government services across key citizen life moments, working with agencies to streamline systems and processes for a smooth, consistent experience — whether online, on the phone, or in person. 

As part of this transformation, you will collaborate with our scrum team of technologists and various government agencies to inform product, design, and strategy decisions that shape the digital experience of public services. This role calls for strong analytical thinking, interpersonal skills, and design judgement. 

You will work closely with designers, engineers, business analysts, and product managers to deliver features that enhance citizen experience and improve agency efficiency.  

This position is with the ServiceSG team located at The Treasury.
jobResponsibilities:
What to expect 

Working closely with the lead in the product strategy team, you will serve as the guardian to ensure consistency and quality across agency integrations, feature development, and platform enhancements, while maintaining a cohesive user experience aligned with the platform strategy. 

Within your first month...  
You have understood the overall product strategy, did a stock take on the status of the project, and contributed service design, planning and strategy for concurrent active sprints.   

By the end of 3 months... 
- Clear ownership of one or more initiatives 
- Good working relationships with internal and cross-agency stakeholders 
- A reliable delivery cadence and transparent reporting 
- Demonstrated understanding of policy–tech–service relationship 
- Delivered small but meaningful progress toward citizen or service impact 

After 6 months... 
- Demonstrates understanding of both delivery and governance 
- Is trusted by internal teams and agency partners 
- Has delivered tangible progress toward citizen-facing or service goals 
- Is starting to shape better practices for delivery and coordination 

Beyond that... 
You will continue to solve problems such as:   
- creating a seamless experience for citizens across e-services 
- helping citizens complete the service with ease 
- resolving agency pain points and improving ops efficiency 
- using data to improve government services
jobRequirements:
How to succeed 

Product and user-centric mindset: 
- A desire to serve the public through the use of technology. 
- Understanding of user-centred design principles. 
- You need to be able to grasp the use case and come up with the task flows in a short span of time. 
- You are able to drive product solutions that service the goals of both the users and stakeholders. 
- You are collaborative and understand that co-creating a product with the team and stakeholders will have a higher chance of it being the best product. 
- You identify the most efficient path to conceptualize, validate, and launch a product feature. You champion an agile and lean approach. 
- You are inherently data-driven, leveraging user research and analytics to inform and validate product decisions. 
- You yearn to analyse user feedback and activity, and iterating the design to enhance user experience. 

Technologist at work: 
- You are meticulous and possess good problem solving skills. 
- You are abreast with current technologies and trends as with future and/or upcoming technologies. 

Strategist at heart: 
- Strategists hardly work alone. You have to work well with your scrum team and agencies to strategise the product direction together. 
- Good organisational, presentation and listening skills. 
- Be flexible, be a team player, solve problems, and contribute to the UX and product team’s success.

- Experience in Agile and UX development environments and design methodologies like information architecture, UI and taxonomy will be a strong advantage.

• Manage a portfolio of countries and/or regional initiatives and build an understanding of their political economies, economic priorities and relationship with Singapore.

• Build relationships with foreign government officials, businesses, trade associations and other partners.

• Engage Singapore companies and industry stakeholders to understand overseas market opportunities and challenges.
• Work with agencies such as Enterprise Singapore, other government ministries and Singapore's overseas missions to advance whole-of-government economic objectives.
• Help connect Singapore and foreign businesses where government can play a useful facilitative role.

Trade Agreements and Economic Cooperation

• Support the negotiation, implementation and promotion of Singapore's free trade agreements and other bilateral or regional economic cooperation frameworks.
• Work with domestic agencies and foreign counterparts to develop new initiatives and resolve implementation issues.

As Senior Assistant Director, Organisation & Capability Development, you will play a key role in the Division’s transformation, leading an integrated portfolio that strengthens MSF’s organisational effectiveness and prepares our leaders and workforce for evolving needs. 

You will provide professional leadership across organisation development (OD), capability building, learning and leadership development, career development, culture, employee engagement and well-being.

Work with functional leads to develop learning and leadership frameworks and roadmaps, and drive career development frameworks, tools and programmes that help officers build skills, broaden experience and prepare for current and future roles.

•	Translate MSF's desired culture, values and behaviours into practical leadership, team and workplace practices: Build OD and change capability across MSF so key stakeholders can continue to drive and sustain outcomes within their areas.

•	Build an engaged, connected and resilient workforce: Identify emerging employee-engagement and well-being needs and translate insights into relevant priorities and interventions. Oversee MSF's internal communications approach and employee-listening channels, including surveys and feedback exercises, and guide analysis of workforce sentiments, well-being indicators and emerging concerns to inform organisation-wide and division-level actions. 

Build capability and provide guidance to leaders and stakeholders to strengthen employee engagement, well-being and employee-support practices, and review the reach and effectiveness of interventions to ensure that they remain relevant and sustainable.

As an employer, we believe in developing our people to do their life’s best work through the 3Ps: Purposeful Work, Professional Growth, People & Culture.

Purposeful Work – Beyond being a pension fund, we are unique in being a national social security organisation, and we serve CPF members knowing that our work we make a difference.

Professional Growth – At CPF Board, you will have the opportunity to learn on the job, acquire new skills, and broaden your knowledge. Although you are joining one organisation, you will have access to many career paths in the years ahead.

People and Culture – When you join CPF Board, you become part of a mission-oriented organisation with a strong culture of teamwork, collaboration, and innovation. Our people are our greatest asset, and we champion a culture of respect, diversity, and inclusivity, where every voice is heard and contributions are recognised and celebrated. 

We are a recipient of the Enabling Mark (Platinum) by SG Enable, we welcome candidates with disabilities and are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment.

Come and be a part of #TeamCPF today, to make a difference in the lives of others and in the future of Singapore. To learn more about CPF Board, visit our website at www.cpf.gov.sg.
jobDescription:
At #TeamCPF, you’re not just joining a team; you are embracing a culture of excellence, collaboration, and meaningful impact. You will play a pivotal role in empowering over 4 million members to secure their retirement, healthcare, housing needs and better navigate life’s uncertainties.

We thrive on sharp minds and insightful decisions. Your ability to analyse and think critically isn't just valued; it's essential. Every choice you make contributes to our collective success.

Collaboration is our way of life. We believe in the power of effective partnerships and seamless communications across teams. Together, we amplify each other’s strengths and achieve remarkable results.

Our learning never stops. We encourage your inquisitiveness and courage to embrace new challenges head-on. Your agility, readiness to challenge conventions, embrace of data-driven strategies, dedication to learning and applying new skills fuels our innovation and progress.

At the core of everything we do lies a genuine desire to make a difference. We serve our community and support each other with compassion, empathy, and unwavering dedications. Every action we take is guided by a deep sense of purpose and a commitment to those we serve.

Join us at #TeamCPF! Together, let's redefine possibilities and leave a legacy that echoes for generations.
jobResponsibilities:
The Design Excellence Centre (DXC) shapes digital experiences for CPF members. We work with departments across the organisation to create and improve digital services that are easy to use, accessible, and focused on CPF members. This is a product designer role focused on solving complex user problems through research, interaction design, and prototyping.

In this role, you will:

• Work through design problems end-to-end, from identifying user needs and generating concepts to defining a product and crafting how people will interact with it.
• Plan and conduct user research to understand user needs and inform product and design decisions.
• Synthesise business, technology, user, and content requirements into user flows, interaction designs, prototypes, and detailed interface designs.
• Communicate design concepts, rationales, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.
• Work closely with product owners and managers to identify and prioritise product improvements based on needs and evidence.
• Work closely with developers through implementation to ensure the delivered experience reflects the design intent.
jobRequirements:
We value the diverse talents and experiences that each individual brings to the table. While mastery of every requirement may not be necessary, familiarity and expertise in some of the following areas will position you for success within this team.

• Relevant experience designing and delivering end-to-end digital products, with hands-on product design capability across responsive web and native app platforms.
• Able to independently plan and conduct user research and apply findings to inform product and design decisions.
• A background in high-performing product environments with an emphasis on design quality, evidence, and iterative delivery.
• Skilled at advocating for good design practices and user needs with stakeholders, including the ability to negotiate ambiguity while driving work forward.
• Proficiency in contemporary design tools, both physical and digital, such as Figma and FigJam.
• Familiarity with framing complex user and product problems, simplifying user flows, and building wireframes, prototypes, and visual designs.
• Familiarity with design facilitation, documentation, and contributing to governance guides.
• Comfortable experimenting with emerging tools, including AI, to explore, prototype, and test ideas. 
• Adaptable and resourceful in managing competing priorities while maintaining focus on user and organisational outcomes. 
• An owner's mindset with genuine motivation to create meaningful impact through public service and user-centred design.
• A curious disposition with genuine interest in how people think and behave.
• Skills in areas like illustration, animation, UX writing, product management, content strategy, or information architecture will be a bonus. 

The seniority of appointment and actual corporate job title will commensurate with individual work experiences.

Position is on a 1-year full-time contract directly under the payroll of CPF Board with an option to renew, contingent upon confirmation and subject to organisational needs. Additionally, there is potential for emplacement into a permanent position.

What you can expect
Being part of #TeamCPF means embarking on a challenging and rewarding career in a progressive workplace that values productivity and growth. Here's what awaits you:
• Opportunities to engage in a mix of formal and informal training, keeping your skills sharp in our ever-evolving technological landscape.
• Promotion opportunities based on your capability and on-the-job performance.
• A vibrant community of like-minded and friendly colleagues, where collaboration and creativity thrive.
• A hybrid work model that offers flexibility for remote work, subject to exigencies of service.
• Flexible dress code that empowers you to choose your appropriate outfit for the day.
• A comprehensive rewards package that includes annual leave, pro-family leave, medical and dental benefits, and access to recreational activities.

jobResponsibilities:
In this role, you will:

• Engineer, administer and evolve Snowflake platform capabilities that enable secure, reliable and scalable use of the platform across application and data workloads.
• Implement security controls and platform guardrails covering role-based access control, least-privilege access, authentication, encryption, audit logging and periodic access reviews.
• Identify and remediate excessive privileges, vulnerabilities and configuration weaknesses, and strengthen platform security through automation and continuous improvement.
• Manage platform provisioning, configuration, upgrades, integrations, migrations and lifecycle activities across Snowflake and supporting Azure services.
• Monitor and optimise SQL queries, workload performance, virtual warehouse sizing, resource utilisation and credit consumption while maintaining operational resilience.
• Design and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform, together with version control and CI/CD practices, to enable consistent, secure and auditable platform changes.
• Develop automation, monitoring and observability capabilities using scripting and platform tooling to streamline administration, identify issues early and improve platform reliability.
• Collaborate with cybersecurity, infrastructure and application teams on platform engineering, security assessments, incident investigations, audit remediation, recovery and business continuity activities.
jobRequirements:
We value the diverse talents and experiences that each individual brings to the table. While mastery of every requirement may not be necessary, familiarity and expertise in some of the following areas will position you for success within this team.

•  Relevant experience in hands-on administration and engineering of Snowflake environments, including databases, schemas, virtual warehouses, access controls, monitoring and operational support.
•  Applied knowledge of Snowflake architecture, SQL and query optimisation, workload management, secure data sharing, resource utilisation and platform performance tuning.
•  Applied knowledge of database and data security principles, including least privilege, role-based access, identity management, encryption, security hardening, auditing and sensitive data protection.
•  Experience with Azure cloud services and cloud operations, including the application of security and governance controls in cloud environments.
•  Experience using Terraform or equivalent Infrastructure-as-Code tools, with familiarity in version control and CI/CD practices for secure, repeatable and auditable platform changes.
•  Ability to automate administration, monitoring and security-related activities using Python, PowerShell or similar scripting languages.
•  Knowledge of database resilience, recovery testing and business continuity, with experience in SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or other database platforms considered advantageous.
•  Ability to identify and address security and operational risks, exercise sound judgement, take accountability for platform outcomes, and collaborate effectively across technical teams.

The seniority of appointment and actual corporate job titles will be commensurate with individual work experience.

The position is on a 2-year full-time contract directly on the payroll of CPF Board with potential for emplacement into a permanent position.

agencyDescription: We aim to build a cohesive and resilient society, deepening the sense of national identity and affinity for Singapore through strengthening community bonds, promoting of the arts and heritage, youth engagement, sports development, volunteerism and philanthropy.
jobDescription:
We are the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth (MCCY). We’re here to build a confident and resilient Singapore, and what that means is a fulfilled and engaged people living in a cohesive and caring society. •	Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship-building skills 
•	Commitment to service excellence, adaptability and ability to work under tight deadlines 
•	Intellectual curiosity and openness to learning, with an awareness of the wider operating context  
•	Strong writing, numerical/financial, and organisational abilities

jobTitle: Quality Service Executive, Ministry of Law Services Centre
agencyDescription:
In Singapore, having the rule of law and advancing people’s access to justice are not just lofty ideals but the backbone of a functioning and a progressive society. At the Ministry of Law, not only do we contribute to developing the legal frameworks and policies that uphold our way of life, but also to providing community legal services that Singaporeans benefit from. The key policies we oversee include Singapore’s legal and intellectual property infrastructure, the civil and criminal justice systems as well as land resources.

Our officers are experts from different fields, and enjoy an excellent and challenging career in a fast-paced environment with plenty of opportunity to grow. If you share our vision of shaping the future of Singapore, you will definitely fit right in here at MinLaw.
jobDescription: You will assist the Quality Service team to handle the daily public queries received by the Ministry. Such public queries will include those received from our official contact channels, as well as appeals made by Members of Parliament (MPs) on behalf of their constituents and inter-agency referrals. You are expected to triage public queries and feedback received and work with relevant stakeholders to ensure these are properly followed up and closed. You will also assist to review public feedback and suggestions and assess the issues raised within; and liaise with the various Divisions within the Ministry on improvements to the overall service systems and processes.
jobResponsibilities:
Responsibilities:

- Assist the Quality Service team to handle the daily public feedback and queries received by the Ministry and ensure timely follow up and closure in accordance with the approved service level timelines. You may also be expected to deal with the members of the public in the course of your work.
 
- Assist the Quality Service Team to identify process gaps and IT system-related issues and suggest enhancements to improve the team’s efficiency.
jobRequirements:
Requirements:
 
-  Diploma in Communications or any other relevant discipline   
- Good command of written and spoken English and one other language. 
Ability to speak one of the dialects will also be an asset.
- Team player, customer service oriented, self-driven and able to work independently.
- At least 2 – 3 years of working experience in customer service and good track record. 
- Proficient in MS Applications and CRM systems
 

Successful candidates will be offered a 1-year contract in the first instance.

agencyDescription:
The Internal Security Department (ISD) confronts and addresses threats to Singapore’s internal security and stability. For over 75 years, ISD and its predecessor organisations have played a central role in countering threats such as those posed by foreign subversive elements, spies, racial and religious extremists, and terrorists.

At the heart of our work are the collection of intelligence that enables us to size up the threats to Singapore’s internal security, and taking the executive actions necessary to overcome those threats. Every day, we collect and analyse intelligence, make impartial assessments, and take decisive action to counter the threats to Singapore’s internal security and stability, and sovereignty.
jobDescription:
ISD confronts and addresses threats to Singapore’s internal security and stability. For over 70 years, ISD and its predecessor organisations have played a central role in countering threats such as those posed by foreign subversive elements, spies, racial and religious extremists, and terrorists. A fulfilling and rewarding career awaits those who want to join in ISD’s critical mission of keeping Singapore safe, secure and sovereign for all Singaporeans.

As a Data Security Specialist, you will be working on one or more of the following functional roles:
jobResponsibilities:
•	Conduct regular data security risk assessments across diverse business scenarios to safeguard data integrity and ensure strict confidentiality of corporate data.
•	Design and implement data security controls in systems and processes to protect sensitive information against unauthorized access or breaches.
•	Oversee user access management processes to ensure permissions for sensitive data are strictly controlled and appropriately granted.
•	Monitor ongoing data usage and activities to maintain data confidentiality and ensure alignment with established business requirements.
•	Advise cross-functional teams on IM8 and industry data security best practices and compliance standards.
•	Lead investigations and responses to data security breaches and incidents to mitigate risk and minimize operational impact.
•	Maintain and update security documentation and operating procedures to ensure continuous compliance with evolving regulations and support organizational knowledge management.
•	Monitor and evaluate emerging data security technologies for potential implementation to help optimise internal data security operation. 
•	Able to work across multiple functions, influencing senior stakeholders, and communicating complex data security topics clearly to both technical and business audiences.
•	Support Data Governance team for the implementation of the data awareness programme (e.g. training, edm etc) to ensure ISD officers are equipped with the knowledge on proper handling of data in their daily work.
jobRequirements:
•	Degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Engineering and other related disciplines. 
•	Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Risk and Information Security Control (CRISC), ISO 27001 etc are preferred but not mandatory.
•	A minimum of 5 years’ experience in data security, cybersecurity, data architecture, Data Governance, IT governance, IT auditor, enterprise risk management or related fields is preferred. 
•	Demonstrated experience in implementing or operationalizing data security or security tools within an organization.
•	Familiar with IM8 on data management, cybersecurity principles and processes would be an advantage. 
•	Proficient in writing and leveraging data audit and analytical tools to inform insights. 
•	Able to work across multiple functions, influencing senior stakeholders, and communicating complex data security topics clearly to both technical and business audiences.
•	Skilled in engaging, influencing, and presenting confidently to senior leaders and stakeholders to drive alignment, decisions, and sustained adoption. 
•	Applicants who are keen to build a career in data security but with no experience are welcome to apply.
•	Only Singaporeans need apply.

jobDescription: As an MOF Social Programmes Officer, you will help shape policies and resource allocation across key social sector initiatives. This role offers you a unique opportunity to advance leading policy ideas, drive synergies, and optimise resources to achieve whole-of-government strategic outcomes across social ministries, such as MOH, MSF, MOE, and MOM.
jobResponsibilities: You will be responsible for managing the budget and manpower requirements of the agencies under your purview, spanning a diverse range of issues such as national subsidies and grants, major infrastructure projects, governance frameworks, and funding and operating models of key services.

These perspectives will put you in good stead to advise agencies on key policy risks and trade-offs, the broader implications of their proposals, as well as best practices from other parts of Government.

TP’s caring and vibrant culture is firmly rooted in our core values which drive a spirit of innovation, with a focus on industry, globalization and sustainability.  “TP Cares” is our clarion call to ensure that our diverse community of learners has the opportunity to achieve their personal best, so that they can contribute meaningfully to the global community.

Learner. Creator. Leader
We envision the TP graduate as a values-led leader with vision, character and heart, excelling in the academic domain and beyond, and rising to the challenge of creating tomorrow.
jobDescription: Temasek Polytechnic's School of Business is looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic individual in the field of sustainability reporting / sustainability finance who is dedicated to inspiring and preparing learners for a successful career.
jobResponsibilities:
The successful candidate is expected to fulfil the following responsibilities, mainly:

  • Distil the knowledge and skills required for corporate sustainability, sustainability reporting, sustainability assurance, sustainability finance and related disciplines into stackable teaching units for Pre-Employment Training (PET) and Continuing Education and Training (CET) training programmes.
  • Develop teaching and assessment curriculum and course materials for PET and CET learners, to drive teaching excellence.
  • Conduct PET classes and CET training, in accordance to teaching quality standards of TP.
  • Collaborate with industry partners to provide industry linkages to the teaching curriculum, including curriculum enhancement and authentic learning experiences for students.
  • Leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI), data analytics, and digital tools to enhance teaching, learning experience, assessment, and the practical application of sustainability reporting and assurance.
  • Engage with industry projects/workgroups related to sustainability reporting or sustainability finance.

Beyond domain expertise, the successful candidate is also expected to:

  • Contribute to school activities, poly-based committees and/or inter-poly activities.
  • Lead, mentor and coach students, in school curriculum, school activities and/or interest groups/student groups.
  • Organise and administer student-related/school activities such as learning journeys, and student educational trips.
  • Teach one or more business fundamental subjects such as Economics, Statistics, Marketing, Business Management and/or Applied Analytics.
jobRequirements:
• Qualification in Finance, Accountancy, Business, Environmental Science, Sustainability or a related field. Training or certifications aligned with the Sustainability Reporting Body of Knowledge (SR BOK) or the Sustainability Assurance Body of Knowledge (SA BOK) are preferred.
  • Has 3 to 5 years of working experience in relevant field with exposure to sustainability reporting and corporate sustainability in local contexts is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of Singapore sustainability reporting frameworks and standards.
  • Knowledge of technologies and trends in sustainability reporting.
  • Ability to communicate and collaborate with others to drive impact and positive learning outcomes.
  • Possesses a growth mindset to stay abreast of industry developments.
  • Strong administrative skills with ability to stay focused on task at hand and to multi-task effectively when the need arises.
  • Digitally savvy and able to leverage digital tools for work and learning.
  • Passion in coaching, mentoring, and guiding students.

jobTitle: Senior Manager, Innovation Strategy & Partnerships (Innovation Systems)
agencyDescription: EDB is the lead government agency responsible for planning & executing strategies to enhance Singapore's position as a global business centre and grow the Singapore Economy. We dream, design and deliver solutions that create value for investors and companies in Singapore. Through that, we attract economic opportunities and jobs for the people of Singapore and help shape our country's economic future.
jobDescription:
About EDB
The Singapore Economic Development Board (EDB), a government agency under the Ministry of Energy, Trade and Industry (METI), is responsible for strategies that enhance Singapore’s position as a global centre for business, innovation and talent. We undertake investment promotion and industry development, and work with international businesses by providing information, connection to partners and access to government incentives for their investments. Our mission is to create sustainable economic growth, with vibrant business and good job opportunities for Singapore.

For more information on EDB, please visit www.edb.gov.sg.


About Innovation Strategy and Partnerships (ISP) – Innovation Systems
The Innovation Strategy & Partnerships division in EDB charts the agency’s vision towards an innovation-led economy by developing strategies to enhance the innovation ecosystem for foreign companies to create new products, services and businesses in Singapore. This includes analysing metrics to track Singapore’s progress in innovation, developing frameworks, tools and incentive schemes, and collaborating across internal teams and other government agencies to co-create solutions to advance Singapore’s innovation agenda.
jobResponsibilities:
[Strategy Development]

Develop and co-create solutions to strengthen Singapore as an innovation economy:

  • Identify, through research and stakeholder engagement, potential gaps in Singapore’s innovation ecosystem (e.g. partnerships, intellectual property, etc.)

  • Analyse and synthesise findings to characterise innovation gaps, challenges and needs

  • Develop value propositions and co-create solutions to strengthen Singapore as an innovation economy, in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders (e.g. industry groups in EDB, other government agencies and industry partners)

[Planning and Data Analysis]

Review, refine and develop Singapore’s overall strategy in innovation:

  • Analyse project data to define EDB’s contributions to innovation and characterise industry/ company needs

  • Measure outcomes of our R&D and innovation policies and map Singapore’s strengths in innovation

Note that this is an individual contributor role. You may also need to perform secretariat duties and support agenda setting for inter-agency platforms.
jobRequirements:
• At least 4 years of relevant working experience in design thinking, strategy/ product development, innovation, IP/ technology commercialisation, corporate planning and/ or policy analysis.

  • Skillset in quantitative data analysis (e.g. Excel, Tableau, Python etc.) will be a plus.

  • Passionate about developing levers to strengthen Singapore’s innovation economy

  • Keen sense of business acumen with strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills

  • Resourceful with a self-starter mindset and strong ability to develop and execute ideas and initiatives

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to engage and influence senior leaders and diverse stakeholders.

  • Strong team player in an agile environment who is versatile and open to learn, explore and experiment

  • Singaporean

We review applications and interview on a rolling basis.

agencyDescription: Sentosa Development Corporation (SDC) was established on 1 September 1972 as a Statutory Board under the Ministry of Trade and Industry. Its charter since inception has been to oversee the development, management and promotion of the Sentosa Island as a resort destination for locals and tourists. Under the care of SDC, the island went through a makeover to become a premier getaway with multi-faceted appeal. From business conventions to beach parties, Sentosa caters to an extensive range of needs and interests. SDC has evolved and grown over the years. It currently oversees the following business and commercial units – Sentosa Leisure Management Pte Ltd, Sentosa Golf Club, Sentosa Cove Resort Management Pte Ltd and Mount Faber Leisure Group.
jobDescription: Plan, manage and implement major infrastructure development projects under the Greater Sentosa Master Plan (GSMP), including design management, procurement, stakeholder coordination and project delivery from inception to completion.
jobResponsibilities:
Key Responsibilities

• Manage and coordinate major infrastructure development projects under the Greater Sentosa Master Plan (GSMP), from project inception, planning and design to procurement, construction and handover.

• Develop project implementation plans, programmes, project briefs, technical requirements and specifications for the procurement of consultancy and construction contracts.

• Manage design development, including reviewing and assessing consultants' technical proposals and design submissions to ensure compliance with project requirements.

• Manage and coordinate multidisciplinary consultants and project teams to ensure effective integration of engineering disciplines and timely delivery of project milestones.

• Identify and manage project interfaces with adjoining developments, existing infrastructure, utilities and other interfacing parties, and develop appropriate mitigation measures.

• Engage and coordinate with internal stakeholders, government agencies and external partners to resolve planning, technical and implementation issues and facilitate necessary approvals.

• Identify and assess project risks, including potential impacts on cost, programme, safety and quality, and develop appropriate mitigation measures.

• Manage consultancy and construction contracts, monitor project progress and performance, and ensure compliance with contractual, statutory and regulatory requirements.

• Evaluate technical and project issues, develop practical solutions and provide recommendations to support management decisions and timely resolution of issues.

• Work independently and collaboratively with multidisciplinary project teams to ensure projects are delivered safely, within approved budgets and programmes, and in accordance with specified quality standards.

• Conduct regular site visits and inspections to monitor construction progress, workmanship, quality and compliance with project requirements, and coordinate the resolution of site issues.

Requirements

• Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Civil Engineering.

• Minimum of 12 years of relevant post-graduate experience in the construction or infrastructure development industry.

• Proven project management experience in large-scale engineering infrastructure projects, including managing contracts valued at S$100 million or more.

• Experience in design and/or design management of multidisciplinary engineering or infrastructure projects would be an advantage.

• Experience in major transport infrastructure, underground infrastructure, reclamation or other complex civil engineering projects would be an advantage.

• Good understanding of engineering design, construction methodologies, project planning, procurement and contract management.

• Strong project management, stakeholder coordination and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage complex project interfaces and recommend practical solutions.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively with multidisciplinary project teams.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to engage stakeholders from diverse backgrounds.
jobRequirements:
This is a 3-year contract with the possibility of renewal.

We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

jobTitle: Deputy Head/Assistant Head, Manufacturing, Trade & Connectivity

jobDescription:
The Fiscal Policy Directorate in MOF is responsible for formulating and implementing fiscal strategies and frameworks to optimise the allocation of finite public resources, to maintain macroeconomic stability (e.g. through countercyclical fiscal policies), support economic growth, and promote social equity. This requires making difficult trade-offs across competing strategic priorities in the social, economic, security and infrastructure domains, while considering progressivity and inter-generational equity. Our work ensures that we can balance the budget and have sufficient resources to advance Singapore’s key priorities, for the benefit of Singaporean households and businesses. 

We ensure fiscal sustainability over the medium to long term by setting out plans for our revenue (e.g. taxes, returns on investment of reserves, Government fees), financing (e.g. use of bonds), expenditure, and public sector manpower priorities. This requires close collaboration with our colleagues across MOF, as well as other Government agencies.  

We are looking for a self-driven and highly motivated individual, with an interest in working with data, to join our dynamic and collaborative team. You will have the opportunity to gain a strategic overview of the government’s priorities, manage trade-offs among competing needs, and shape the public policy agenda. You will also have the opportunity to review and operationalise our budgetary policies (e.g. Block Budgets, Programme Budgets, Reinvestment Fund, Manpower Management Framework, debt management) to support our macro-allocation objectives. As a Fiscal Policy Associate, you will be required to consult widely at all levels, synthesise and analyse information effectively, generate robust policy options and exercise sound judgment over trade-offs.
jobResponsibilities:

Policymaking 
1.	Formulate, review and implement fiscal, budgeting, revenue, financing, debt management and public sector manpower policies to enable optimal allocation of resources across the Government and ensure fiscal sustainability 

Strategic Planning 
2.	Horizon scanning and research of future economic and social challenges/opportunities, and study the implications for Singapore 
3.	Formulate Singapore’s fiscal strategies and response to these key challenges and seed ideas for major public policy shifts 

Managing Stakeholders and Trade-offs 
4.	Work closely with stakeholders to shape the Government’s revenue and expenditure plans and ensure alignment and coherence with the Government’s strategic priorities 
5.	Analysis of fiscal impact of major policy changes and public spending programmes and manage the trade-offs across different sectors 

Data Analytics 
6.	Analyse fiscal and macroeconomic data to sense-make the impact of fiscal policies 
7.	Model and project our revenue and expenditure over the medium to long term

jobDescription:
The Housing & Development Board (HDB) is building digital products and services that improve the lives of Singaporeans. We believe great products start with a deep understanding of people, and we are committed to building experiences that are intuitive, accessible and useful.

We are looking for a Senior UX Designer (Design Systems) to build and evolve our design system and the AI tools around it. You will help designers and engineers build consistent, accessible products faster, and make sure AI tools produce work that follows the system. This role suits someone who is equally comfortable in Figma, in a code repository, and in a conversation with designers about how they work.
jobResponsibilities:
Design system

You will design, build and maintain components, patterns and design tokens, including variants, theming and documentation. You will build accessibility into every component so products meet the Whole-of-Government Digital Service Standards, including WCAG AA. You will work with front-end engineers to keep design and code aligned, using tools such as Code Connect and Storybook.

AI tooling

You will build AI tools that help designers work faster and stay on-system, such as Figma plugins, custom agents, skills and prompt templates. You will structure the design system so AI tools can read and apply it, through machine-readable documentation, tokens and component data exposed through MCP or similar methods. You will write scripts to automate design system tasks such as audits, token sync and documentation. You will test new AI tools and share what works with the design team.

Adoption and governance

You will support the product designers and engineers who use the system, through reviews and clear guidance. You will audit products for one-off patterns and drift, and decide with the team what joins the system. You will run a contribution model so teams can propose and add components. You will track adoption and report where the system helps and where it falls short.
jobRequirements:
• 5+ years of experience in product design, UI design, design engineering or a related discipline, with 2+ years working on a design system.
  • A portfolio showing design system work: components, tokens, documentation, and the effect on the teams who use them.
  • Strong grasp of component architecture, design tokens, variants and theming in Figma.
  • Working knowledge of accessibility standards, including WCAG AA, and how to build them into components.
  • Experience building AI tools for design work, such as Figma plugins, custom agents, skills or prompt templates.
  • Experience making design system content usable by AI tools, such as structured documentation or MCP servers.
  • Ability to write scripts with the Figma API, JavaScript or similar to automate design tasks.
  • Comfortable working in GitHub with engineers.
  • Clear writing for documentation and guidelines.

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • You have contributed component code through pull requests.
  • You have worked with token pipelines, Code Connect or Storybook.
  • You have supported several products on one design system.
  • You have helped a design team adopt AI tools.
  • You are curious, practical and generous with your knowledge.

• Facilitate communication and follow-ups between the various teams involved in the testing process to ensure timely and effective resolution of issues.
• Maintain clear and accurate project documentation, including meeting minutes, test plans, test cases, defect logs, and status reports.
• Leverage AI tools where appropriate to enhance productivity and the quality of work, such as drafting documentation, analysing data, generating test cases, or summarising meeting discussions.

jobDescription:
We are looking for a senior, hands-on Data Architect to own the data design of our investment management platforms. You will define how investment data is sourced and ingested from multiple systems, structured and integrated within the organisation, governed and made available across front, middle and back office. You will stay close to implementation by producing models and specifications, reviewing build quality, and providing technical leadership to the team’s data specialists. The role must deliver solutions that meet MAS technology standards and applicable Whole of Government compliance requirements.

The role sits in a four-person delivery team set up to establish a unified investment data architecture that enables generative AI use cases. You will design and drive implementation of three unified data layers — portfolio holdings, structured market and economic data, and unstructured research, news and sell-side content — together with the reconciliation and retrieval infrastructure that supports specific use cases across the investment value chain. You will join at the start of the build phase, designing against a product vision and user stories.
jobResponsibilities:
Data architecture and modelling

  • Design and develop the conceptual, logical and physical data models for investment data domains: security and reference data, positions and holdings, transactions, valuations and pricing, performance, benchmarks, risk, compliance, accounting and client reporting.
  • Define and govern golden-source, reference-data and master-data standards for instruments, parties, legal entities, accounts and portfolios, including identifier strategy, entity resolution, lifecycle states, schema versioning and change control.
  • Produce implementation-ready artefacts: DDL, transformation and mapping specifications, interface contracts and data quality rules.
  • Define the IBOR / ABOR data design and the reconciliation points between investment and accounting books of record, with end-to-end auditability.
  • Define source-to-target data flows and mappings centred on SimCorp Dimension, covering market and reference data vendors, custodians, counterparties, and downstream reporting and analytics.

Unstructured data and retrieval architecture

  • Develop the conceptual, logical and physical data models for unstructured investment-information domains, including sell-side and broker research, market commentary, news, internal analytics and knowledge assets.
  • Define the architecture and standards for document ingestion, processing and indexing, ensuring that source context, document structure and temporal attributes are preserved.
  • Define metadata, taxonomy and classification standards for unstructured content to support governance, discoverability and retrieval.
  • Define the architecture and technical standards for the vector database and embedding lifecycle, including embedding model selection, index design, evaluation and retrieval optimisation, and guide the AI Engineer’s implementation.
  • Define the entity and metadata mappings that link unstructured content to portfolio holdings and trades, enabling relevant research and news to be retrieved against current exposures.
  • Design hybrid retrieval orchestration spanning all three layers (vector similarity combined with keyword filtering and metadata ranking) to support near-real-time market surveillance.

Platform and integration

  • Define integration patterns and interface standards for batch, API, messaging and event-driven exchange across the investment-data ecosystem.
  • Shape the target data platform for analytics and reporting across on-premise RDBMS / data warehouse and cloud lakehouse, and guide the migration path between them.
  • Evaluate technology and vendor options, weighing performance, resiliency, security, cost and operational complexity.
  • Take part in platform upgrades, replatforming and data migration, owning data mapping, parallel runs, cutover, reconciliation and legacy decommissioning.

Governance, quality and control

  • Develop the data-governance framework and accountable ownership model covering metadata, business and technical lineage, data quality, retention, and access rights.
  • Ensure designs meet MAS technology standards and Whole of Government compliance requirements.
  • Define data classification and access controls for sensitive investment data, applied consistently across all three layers including unstructured research content.
  • Define source-data lineage and audit requirements for reconciliation outcomes and AI retrieval; work with the AI Engineer to ensure end-to-end traceability across data, retrieval, model and application logs.

Leadership and delivery

  • Serve as the design authority for investment-data architecture, lead data design reviews, and steer change proposals through the MAS Architecture Review Committee to validate alignment with Enterprise Architecture standards.
  • Partner with portfolio management, investment operations, risk, finance, compliance and vendor teams to translate business needs into data designs.
  • Work to a defined cadence with the Investment Operations & Data Domain Expert to validate the holdings model, reconciliation logic and document classification against confirmed user stories, and with the AI Engineer to assess data-layer readiness for agent retrieval.
  • Hold decision authority for investment-data architecture. Make cross-cutting architecture and technical trade-offs jointly with the AI Engineer, subject to validation by the Domain Expert that the proposed design meets operational needs.
  • Translate complex data concepts for senior business and technology stakeholders.
  • Ensure that the data architecture provides governed metadata, semantic definitions and access controls for analytics, machine learning and generative AI use cases.
jobRequirements:
Must have:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • At least 10 years of relevant experience across data architecture, data modelling or senior data engineering, with substantial experience designing data solutions for investment management, asset management, institutional investment, capital markets or closely related financial-services domains.
  • Deep knowledge of investment data domains including security/reference data, positions and holdings, transactions, valuations/pricing, performance, benchmarks and IBOR/ABOR. Experience designing and implementing reconciliations across IBOR, ABOR, custodians, market data providers and downstream reporting systems.
  • Hands on experience with modern data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, or cloud-native data services on AWS or Azure; containerised deployment (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Strong relational database design experience, preferably Oracle, including performance and high-availability considerations.
  • Track record of delivering at least one large-scale data migration or platform replatforming programme in financial services.
  • Working knowledge of data governance, lineage, metadata management and data quality frameworks.
  • Strong hands-on experience in conceptual, logical and physical data modelling, including relational and dimensional modelling, and in producing implementation-ready data specifications.
  • Hands-on experience with vector search and embedding-based retrieval — including vector index design, embedding model selection, and hybrid search combining vector similarity with keyword and metadata filtering.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including producing clear architecture documentation.

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience with front-to-back investment management platforms, including their data models and data management capabilities.
  • Hands-on experience with document parsing and OCR for scanned and text-native PDFs, including layout and table extraction, and with semantic chunking strategies suited to long-form research documents.
  • Experience with market and reference data vendors such as Bloomberg, Refinitiv (LSEG) or ICE, and with economic indicator providers such as Macrobond.
  • Knowledge of private markets data, ESG data, or multi-asset portfolios.
  • Familiarity with data mesh, data products and federated governance concepts.
  • Experience designing data foundations for retrieval-augmented generation or similar AI retrieval patterns in a regulated environment.
  • Programming experience in SQL, Python or Java.

Personal attributes:

  • Balances architectural standards with pragmatic delivery.
  • Comfortable owning design decisions and defending them with evidence.
  • Builds trust with business users and engineers alike.
  • Develops others and raises the team’s design quality.
  • Comfortable designing under a human-in-the-loop operating principle, where every automated output must remain reviewable and auditable.

agencyDescription:
The Singapore Department of Statistics is the National Statistical Authority responsible for statistics on the Singapore economy and population.

We collect, compile, analyse and disseminate a wide range of economic, business, household and population data, as well as analyse and monitor trends in the economy and population.

With these vital inputs, policymakers, business decision makers and our data users gain valuable insights into current and emerging economic and social trends, enabling them to make calculated and informed decisions in the formulation of policies and strategies for the future. Apart from public agencies and businesses, our users also include researchers, analysts, educators, students, the media and the general public.

Join our team and make a difference by contributing important statistical input to facilitate policy planning and decision-making and support Singapore's present and future economic and social development.
jobDescription:
The household sector balance sheet provides insights on the assets and liabilities held by households in Singapore as at end of period. The current compilation workflow involves manual data extraction from multiple different sources with varying input formats and data frequency, and tedious updating of charts and tables for reporting purposes. 

This project aims to overhaul the end-to-end workflow as follows:
i) standardising the ingestion of diverse data sources,
ii) migrating the compilation process from FAME and manual handling to a Python-based workstream, and 
iii) revamping the way compiled data is presented for submission and reporting, including exploring the integration of AI for data analysis and dashboard generation.
iv) introducing automated data validation checks at the point of ingestion, e.g. outlier detection, and completeness checks.
v) Building a centralised metadata repository, e.g. capturing data definitions, update frequencies, source contacts.
vi) Automating production of narrative reports or commentary templates
vii) Documenting new workflow and running structured handover sessions for all users 
viii) Preparing presentation deck on new workflow.
jobResponsibilities: Through this project, we will develop a standardised data ingestion framework, a Python-based compilation workflow to replace existing FAME-dependent processes, and an automated reporting output or dashboard for timely data reporting. In doing so, the selected intern will gain hands-on experience in statistical data processing and compilation, and develop practical skills in Python and AI applications.
jobRequirements:
Proficiency in Python and R programming 
Knowledge or experience in computer science, data science, data analytics, programming, data processing, or process automation.
Internship Period: 6 months, from Jan to Jun 2027 (flexible start and end dates)
Part Time option available, min. 3 days per week

-Monitor the performance of embodied AI systems in real-world environments and iterate for continuous improvement

jobDescription: MED is building its data and analytics capability, and this role sits at the centre of that effort. The Data Analyst will turn MED's operational, programme and policy questions into clear, reliable insights that support decision-making across the division. The officer will work with structured and unstructured data, develop dashboards and analytical products, support programme evaluation, and help MED team members use data more effectively. This role focuses on collecting, analysing and communicating data — it is distinct from a Business Analyst role.
jobResponsibilities:
The officer should focus on areas 1 to 4, with areas 5 and 6 pursued where capacity allows. Area 7 applies across all areas.

1. Data quality and documentation — Review, clean and document MED's operational datasets. Develop data dictionaries, validation rules and methodology notes so the data is reliable and easy for others to maintain.

2. Management dashboards and reporting — Work with MED team members to improve existing Tableau and Excel dashboards, and develop additional dashboards and reports where needed. Present findings as concise narratives with clear recommendations.

3. Programme evaluation —  Using MOF's programme evaluation template as the framework, work with MED’s data team to analyse whether the MEP is achieving its intended outcomes and prepare the required reports and submissions for management and stakeholders.

4. Operational and thematic analysis — Identify trends, patterns, anomalies and risks in MEP operations. Conduct root-cause analysis of complaints, feedback and case records, and write up findings as clear analytical briefs.

5. Unstructured data analysis — Apply text analytics or AI-assisted methods to case notes, complaints and other documents to surface insights not captured in structured data.

6. AI-enabled analytics — Develop small-scale proof-of-concepts for AI or automation in MED's analytics work, with appropriate human oversight and governance.

7. Stakeholder engagement and capability building — Help MED teams frame analytical problems, advise on metrics and methods, and provide hands-on guidance to team members developing dashboards and analytical tools.
jobRequirements:
•	Qualifications in data analytics, statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science, public policy, social sciences or a related discipline, with relevant experience in data analysis, business intelligence, programme evaluation or operations analytics. 
•	Proficiency in Excel and Tableau or equivalent is expected. Experience with SQL, Python or R, and familiarity with text analytics, NLP or generative AI would be an advantage. 
•	Experience with public-sector operations or case-management data is useful but not essential.

Competencies:

[Data quality and collection] Cleans, validates and documents data; designs repeatable collection approaches.

[Analysis and modelling] Examines patterns and relationships; applies suitable quantitative methods with clear assumptions.

[Unstructured data and AI] Applies text analytics or AI methods responsibly, with human oversight and attention to risk.

[Charts and dashboards] Designs clear visualisations that support monitoring and decisions.

[Data storytelling] Communicates findings in plain language tailored to the audience.

[Stakeholder engagement] Frames analytical questions with users and supports appropriate interpretation of findings.

Key deliverables:

•	Management dashboards and recurring reports covering MED's priority indicators, including improvements to existing Tableau and Excel dashboards
•	Programme evaluation analysis supporting MED's MOF reporting commitment
•	Cleaned, documented datasets with data dictionaries and methodology notes to support handover and continued use after the contract ends
•	Thematic and trend analyses of complaints, surveys and case records, written up as analytical briefs with findings, implications and recommended actions
•	(Stretch) Validated AI-assisted workflows for document extraction or classification

This 11-month contract is intended to meet MED's immediate analytics and programme evaluation needs. The officer should be able to contribute with limited lead time and deliver usable outputs, documentation and knowledge transfer within the contract period. Appointment level and any applicable skills allowance remain subject to HR's assessment.

Our mission is to empower individuals and families to break cycles of abuse, neglect and offending. Additionally, PSV/OPS plays a key role in facilitating the child adoption process, ensuring the welfare of both the child and adoptive family. PSV/OPS adopts a holistic approach through early intervention, comprehensive assessments, case management, and crisis response. Our team works in close collaboration with social service agencies, healthcare professionals, law enforcement, and community partners to identify risks, develop safety plans and provide ongoing support.

• Work closely with the public and people sectors to offer statutory guidance, care, and protection for children who have been abused or neglected, and VAs experiencing abuse, neglect or self-neglect.

jobDescription:
The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) is Singapore's central bank and integrated financial regulator. MEPS+ (Central Banking & Devt Platforms Division) is responsible for the MAS Electronic Payment System — a mission-critical system supporting interbank payments, government securities management, and domestic market infrastructure. MEPS+ serves the entire Singapore financial sector and requires 24/7 operational reliability, strict compliance with government regulatory frameworks, and close coordination with financial institutions and government agencies.

As System Manager, you are the operational and delivery owner for MEPS+ and related systems. You own the outcomes, and coordinate across software engineers, product owners, compliance teams, and external vendors to ensure system reliability, regulatory compliance, and successful delivery of enhancements and patches.
jobResponsibilities:
Operational Delivery & Application Portfolio Management

  • Own operational delivery outcomes for the MEPS+ application portfolio across interbank payments, government securities management, and domestic market infrastructures. Make and recommend strategic decisions on application rationalisation, consolidation, or decommissioning to optimise portfolio efficiency.
  • Coordinate release management and delivery cycles with product owners, ensuring timely and quality deployment of enhancements, patches, and security updates across major (semi-annual) and monthly patch cycles.
  • Own Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for applications under management. Review SLI and SLO performance reports produced by the SRE team, identify trends and deviations, and escalate or drive remediation as appropriate. Set requirements for monitoring coverage and alert quality; hold the SRE team accountable for outcomes.
  • Coordinate verification of monthly and quarterly system patching with the SRE team. Ensure patch outcomes are documented and meet compliance requirements.

Tech Delivery Manager Responsibilities (During Release Cycles)

  • Lead release planning and delivery activities during major enhancement releases (semi-annual). Coordinate with product owners, development teams, testing teams, and vendors to establish release scope, timelines, and deployment readiness criteria.
  • Manage release communication to all stakeholders. Provide status updates, escalate blockers, and maintain stakeholder alignment on release objectives and timelines throughout the cycle.
  • Own release governance and quality standards for MEPS+. Define the release readiness criteria and test governance framework that the Software Engineer executes against. Review and sign off on test outcomes, patch verification results, and release readiness reports before production deployment.

Incident Management

  • Own the incident management framework for MEPS+. Define and maintain incident escalation paths, SLO targets (P1, P2, P3), and communication protocols. During major incidents, lead stakeholder communication and coordinate the response — software engineers provide technical investigation and resolution support.
  • Drive root cause analysis and post-mortems following significant incidents. Own the documentation of lessons learned and track implementation of preventive measures to reduce recurrence.

Vendor Coordination & Procurement

  • Own vendor governance for outsourced components and services. Chair vendor performance reviews, monitor SLA compliance, and make escalation decisions when vendor performance falls short. Coordinate with software engineers for detailed technical review of vendor-delivered code and fixes.
  • Lead MAS's participation in procurement activities for outsourced services, including defining tender specifications, evaluating vendor proposals, and contributing to contract negotiations.

Compliance, Governance & Risk Management

  • Coordinate RFI responses across the team, ensuring accurate and timely submission of supporting documentation.
  • Plan and lead resiliency exercises including Disaster Recovery drills, manual contingency procedures, and CyberEx participation. Validate system failover and recovery capabilities. Maintain compliance with ICT Governance policies and standards specific to government financial infrastructure.
jobRequirements:
Essential Criteria

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in managing, operating, or delivering complex mission-critical systems. Minimum 3–4 years in a delivery management, operations management, or technical programme management role with clear accountability for system reliability or release outcomes. Experience with payment systems, securities settlement, or financial infrastructure is advantageous but not required.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead incident response at an organisational level — owning stakeholder communication, driving post-mortems, and implementing systemic improvements. Track record of managing high-stakes operational environments.
  • Proven experience managing vendor relationships, chairing performance reviews, and holding vendors accountable to SLAs. Experience contributing to procurement or contract management activities.
  • Strong experience coordinating release cycles across multiple teams — development, testing, operations, and compliance — with accountability for release readiness decisions.
  • Excellent communication skills. Able to explain technical risks, operational decisions, and compliance requirements clearly to senior leadership, business stakeholders, and regulators. Strong written communication for incident reports, post-mortems, audit RFI responses, and governance documentation.
  • Comfortable working across technical domains without requiring deep hands-on expertise in every platform. Able to engage credibly with software engineers and SRE colleagues, ask the right questions, and make informed decisions based on their input.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams — incident response, release coordination, compliance activities, vendor management — without losing attention to detail or governance rigour.

Desirable Criteria

  • Familiarity with Java/J2EE application environments, Linux/RHEL systems, or SQL — sufficient to engage meaningfully with engineering teams and understand technical risk, without necessarily being a hands-on practitioner.
  • Experience with containerisation technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) or cloud platforms (OpenShift, OpenStack) at a conceptual or governance level.
  • Experience with CICD pipelines, release automation, and test management frameworks.
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms (e.g. Grafana, ELK stack) from an operational governance perspective.
  • Familiarity with government IT environments and regulatory compliance frameworks (CCoP, CSP, AGO, IM8).
  • Agile delivery experience and comfort collaborating with product teams and development teams.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g. ITIL, PMP, AWS Solutions Architect, or equivalent).

As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment.

This is a 2-Year Contract. All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.

jobDescription:
In an era of rapid and significant change, the Public Service's operational landscape is evolving. We are confronted with intricate challenges that necessitate a reimagined approach to service delivery. The Public Sector Transformation (PST) initiative is our response to these changes, with ServiceSG at the forefront of revolutionizing public service delivery. 

 

As part of the current phase of PST, ServiceSG aims to be on par with globally leading companies in our delivery of public services. A key transformation in the delivery of citizen services is to take a citizen-centric service journey approach to organising services in an integrated manner via a) a digital concierge via the LifeSG app, b) a physical concierge via an expanded network of Service Centres; and c) a central contact centre. Our aim is to transform the current citizen experience of having to navigate across different public agencies to an experience of the Public Service “knowing, understanding and interacting with me as One”. 

 

There are currently hundreds of hotlines across the Whole of Government (WOG). The Contact Centre team in ServiceSG aims to work with agencies who own these hotlines to streamline and integrate these contact centres, especially those that provide related services. The goal is to establish a central ServiceSG contact centre that can address the queries of citizens across related citizen services, serving as an “outsourced shared service” for selected agencies. The team will also support surges in contact centre call loads for key agencies during peak periods, and act as the central call centre in a national pandemic or crisis. 

 

Are you keen to be part of a revolutionary team that is changing the game in government contact centres? ServiceSG is seeking a dynamic, and forward-thinking Manager to join our innovative Contact Centre team to improve citizen experience through transforming our operations. If you're passionate and interested to learn about ops-tech integration and eager to drive change, we want you to be part of a team that is making a real difference.

Ops Management and Collaboration with Partnering Agencies

However, the sector will need to confront the existential challenges of global climate change, energy and manpower constraints, changing demographics and values, and ageing infrastructure in the coming years. Addressing these challenges requires the ability to manage the trade-offs between the desired outcomes of greater safety, resiliency, quality, sustainability, liveability and as well as to strike a balance between industry regulation and development/promotion.
jobResponsibilities:
You will be part of a passionate policy team in MND’s Infrastructure Division which serves as an advocate for businesses within the Built Environment (BE) sector, seeking and acting on suggestions on how rules and regulations imposed on the industry can be improved, saving businesses time, effort and money, while creating a nimble, forward looking and agile regulatory regime. 

You will champion regulatory innovation by steering rules review efforts across the BE sector. This includes staffing our Political Office Holders for the Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC) on Pro-Enterprise Rules Review which reviews cross-cutting regulatory issues across the Whole-of-Government and reduces compliance burden for businesses.  You will also support regulatory reviews to improve productivity across the BE sector, including through the Action Team to Improve Built Environment Productivity chaired by the Minister for National Development. This will involve working with agencies and industry stakeholders to identify regulatory, process and implementation issues that may affect productivity, and propose practical measures to streamline requirements, strengthen coordination and support sector-wide transformation.

Further, you will lead the transformation of the sector through various initiatives, including encouraging digitalisation and adoption of regulatory technologies across the sector.  In your capacity as Secretariat for the BE Rules Review Panel (RRP) chaired by PS/ND, you will work across 11 public agencies that perform regulatory functions in the BE sector. Our product teams build web applications using cloud-native technologies and enterprise COTS/platform integration to deliver feature-rich applications to achieve better efficiency, effectiveness and employee experience for the organisation.
